3d.an_autonomous_agent_building_a_game_a: Agent yigenga ikora umukino, ishusho, NFT, cyangwa umutungo wo ku isoko ikeneye 3D — kandi ikeneye kwizera ibyo ibona. Iyi API isubiza ibibazo byombi mu gihe cy'akazi: nkoreye model ikomoka kuri iyi nyandiko, na iyi model irakora neza, kandi nayigabanya nte? Nta yindi platform y'ubwishyu bwa agent itanga gukora no kugenzura 3D ku buntu.
3d.assembled_live_from_the_api_catalog_ever: Byegeranyijwe ako kanya muri kataloge ya API. Buri murongo urafunguye kandi ntukeneye urufunguzo.
3d.copy_run_done_no_key_no_header: Kora kopi, koresha, birarangiye. Nta rufunguzo, nta mutwe, nta konti. Ibi bihamagara API nyayo ikoreshwa.

3d.everything_the_api_touches_is_a_real: Buri kimwe API ikoraho ni GLB nyayo, yujuje ibisabwa — iforuma imwe moteri yawe, umureba, cyangwa isoko ryawe bisanzwe bikoresha. Kurura kugira ngo uzenguruke.
3d.generous_per_ip_rate_limit: Umubare ntarengwa w'ibikorwa kuri buri IP utanga byinshi
3d.give_your_ai_agent_a_3d_toolchain: Ha umukozi wa AI wawe ibikoresho bya 3D. Hindura amagambo yanditsemo GLB nyayo ifite imiterere, genzura kandi unonosore glTF/GLB iyo ari yo yose — ubuntu, nta rufunguzo, nta konti. Iyo inyandiko y'ibanze idahagije, API imwe igera ku byiciro bya Forge Pro bikoreshwa mu gukora no ku ma-Avatar yateguwe gukoreshwa mu gukina amashusho.

3d.meta_description: API ya 3D y'ubuntu, idakeneye urufunguzo, yagenewe abakozi ba AI: hindura amagambo yanditsemo GLB nyayo, genzura kandi unonosore glTF/GLB iyo ari yo yose, hanyuma ugere ku byiciro by'ubuziranenge bwa Forge Pro bishyurwa no ku ma-Avatar yateguwe. URL imwe yo kubisanga byose — nta konti, nta rufunguzo rwa API.
3d.meta_og_description: 3D y'ubuntu, idakeneye urufunguzo, yagenewe abakozi: kuvana amagambo mu nyandiko y'ibanze ya 3D + kugenzura glTF/GLB, hamwe n'inyandiko isobanutse ya OpenAPI 3.1 n'urwego rwo kwishyura ruganisha ku buziranenge bwo gukoresha.

3d.meta_twitter_description: API ya 3D y'ubuntu, idakoresha urufunguzo, igenewe abakozi ba AI: hindura amagambo yanditsemo ikaba model ya GLB nyayo, ungenzure/unonosore glTF/GLB iyo ari yo yose, byose bikorwa ukoresheje URL imwe gusa ifite OpenAPI 3.1 spec ikora. Gukora inyandiko mbanziriza no kuyisuzuma ku buntu bigera ku rwego rwa Forge Pro rwishyurwa n'ama-avatar yateguwe yiteguye gukoreshwa mu ma-animation. Nta rufunguzo, nta konti.
3d.output_is_binary_gltf_glb_the_web: Ibisohoka ni binary glTF (GLB) — agasanduku ka 3D gakoreshwa kuri interineti buri moteri n'ureba asoma. Kugenzura byemera .glb na .gltf biva kuri URL iyo ari yo yose rusange, kugeza ku rugero ntarengwa rw'ingano rwanditseho.
3d.point_any_openapi_toolchain_at_it: Koresha OpenAPI toolchain iyo ari yo yose kuri yo
3d.pre_baked_idle_walk_clip_library: Aho kubika amashusho y'imyitwarire yo guhagarara no kugenda yateguwe
3d.programmatically_over_x402_http_402_usdc: Mu buryo bwa porogaramu, binyuze kuri x402 (HTTP 402 + USDC kuri Base cyangwa Solana). Nta guhanahana urufunguzo — umukozi asubiramo gusa icyifuzo afite umutwe w'ubwishyu. Reba x402 Bazaar yishyuwe kugira ngo ubone urutonde rwuzuye.
3d.real_glb_not_a_screenshot: GLB nyayo, si ifoto yafashwe kuri ecran
3d.start_free_upgrade_only_when_a_draft: Tangira ku buntu. Uzamure urwego gusa igihe inyandiko mbanziriza idahagije. Urwego rwishyurwa rwishyurwa buri koreshwa muri USDC binyuze kuri x402 — nta konti, nta n'urufunguzo.
3d.text_3d_and_image_3d_pipelines: Imikorere ihindura amagambo akaba 3D n'amashusho akaba 3D
3d.text_3d_draft_nim_trellis_single_subject: Inyandiko mbanziriza ya Text→3D (NIM TRELLIS): ikintu kimwe gusa, GLB, nta gutegura
3d.this_is_a_live_gltf_binary_rendered: Iyi ni binary ya glTF ikora igaragara muri mushakisha yawe. Endpoint y'ubuntu /api/3d/inspect itanga amakuru y'ukuri ku byiri muri ibi — vertices, triangles, ibikoresho, textures, animations, extensions — n'igishushanyo mbonera cyihutirwa cyo kuyigira nto kandi yihuta.
3d.yes_no_account_no_api_key_no: Yego. Nta konti, nta API key, nta wallet. Endpoints z'ubuntu zifite urugero ntarengwa rwo gukoresha kuri buri IP rurinda gusa gukoresha nabi. Urwego rw'ubuntu rwo gukora inyandiko mbanziriza rukoresha umuhanda wa GPU usangiwe — rwerekana neza ko ari urwego rwo kugerageza (draft geometry, GLB gusa, nta gutegura).

Hanze y'urwo rwego nta kintu yiyitirira.

alpha_copilot.pick_an_agent_it_reads_a_real: Toranya umugenzi. Isoma ikorwa ririho ubu rya nyabyo mu buryo bwihariye — ivuga ibimenyetso bya nyabyo by'amafaranga ahari, abafite, n'amafaranga y'abahanga yabonye — kandi ikavuga umwanzuro wayo mu ijwi riranguruye binyuze muri avatar yayo ya 3D. assistant.one_script_tag_adds_a_floating_launcher: Script tag imwe yongeraho launcher igenda kuri site yawe. Kanda kuri yo maze avatar ya 3D nyayo, ikora, iragaragara — kuri page yawe, ibara, cyangwa gradient — ifite uburyo bubiri: chatbot isubiza ibibazo (models z'ubuntu, cyangwa uzane urufunguzo rwawe rwa Groq / OpenRouter), n'uburyo bwo kuvuga aho avatar ivuga neza icyo wanditse, mu ijwi riranguruye, muri speech bubble.
assistant.paste_it_before_on_any_site_chat: Andika iyi mbere ya </body> kuri site iyo ari yo yose. Ibisubizo bya chat bituruka kuri free model chain (Groq → OpenRouter → NVIDIA) mu buryo busanzwe; abashyitsi bashobora guhindurira ku rufunguzo rwabo rwa Groq cyangwa OpenRouter mu igenamiterere rya widget — urufunguzo ruguma muri browser yabo. autopilot.meta_description: Shyira igiceri cyawe cya pump.fun kuri autopilot. Agent yawe ikora buybacks ikanatanga amafaranga y'abaremye ku bafite igiceri hashingiwe ku mategeko washyizeho — kandi igasobanura buri gikorwa cyose kuri chain mu gihe nyacyo.

autopilot.your_agent_runs_the_whole_coin_lifecycle: Agent yawe ikora ubuzima bwose bw'igiceri yonyine: igura kandi igatwika amafaranga y'abaremye ikanatanga ibyishyurwa ku bafite igiceri — hashingiwe ku mategeko washyizeho. Buri gikorwa cyose kuri chain gisobanurwa mu buryo bwa live na avatar ya agent yawe.

autopilot_activity.every_action_your_agent_took_on_your: Buri gikorwa umu-agent wawe yakoze mu izina ryawe — buri kimwe gishingiye ku bwenge bwacyo cyagiteye, cyashyizweho umukono, kandi gishobora gusubizwa inyuma aho bishoboka. Uku ni ukwigenga ushobora kugenzura.
autopilot_activity.meta_description: Buri gikorwa cyigenga umu-agent wawe three.ws yakoze — buri kimwe gifite ubwenge bwacyo cyagiteye, inyemezabuguzi yashyizweho umukono, n'uburyo bwo gusubiza inyuma ukoresheje gukanda rimwe. Ukwigenga ushobora gusobanura kandi ukwizera.

avatar_engines.a_factual_map_of_the_open_source: Ikarita y'ukuri y'imikorere ya open-source n'iy'ubucuruzi ikora ama-avatar ya 3D agaragara neza kandi afite ireme ryiza — Gaussian-splat heads, abantu bakozwe n'ifoto imwe, ibikora avatar biva mu nyandiko, n'ibikoresho three.ws isanzwe ikoresha mu gukora amashusho yimuka. Kuri buri kimwe: icyo gikora, aho gikora, icyo uruhushya rwacyo rwemerera, n'uburyo three.ws ikoresha.

Incamake z'amasezerano y'uruhushya ni ubuyobozi, ntabwo ari inama z'amategeko — emeranya n'umushinga w'ibanze mbere yo gukoresha mu bucuruzi ubwo aribwo bwose. Imashini z'ubushakashatsi zidafite inyungu z'ubucuruzi zashyizweho kugira ngo zikoreshwe ku giti cyazo no mu mashuri kandi zidasanzwe zihuza n'uburyo bwo gukora bwishyurwa bwa three.ws. bnb.not_20_000_tps_marketing_three_product: Ntabwo ari kwamamaza '20,000 TPS' — inzira eshatu z'ibicuruzwa zikoresha ubushobozi twigenzuriye bikora kuri BNB Chain ku wa 2026-07-07, ubushobozi Ethereum L1, Base, na (cyane cyane) Solana bidashobora kugeraho by'ukuri. Buri karita iri hepfo igaragaza ibyo ivuga hashingiwe ku byo twapimye, ihuza na demo nyayo iyo yatangiye gukoreshwa, kandi ikavuga 'coming soon' — atari link itakora — iyo itaratangira.
bnb.the_block_time_number_above_is_measured: Umubare w'igihe cya block uri hejuru upimwa ako kanya kuva kuri RPC ya BSC rusange buri uko page ifunguwe (probeBlockTime, ipima blocks nyayo 200) — ntabwo ari '0.45s' yashyizwemo mbere.

bnb.we_never_claim_bnb_s_roadmap_targets: Ntabwo twigera tuvuga ko intego za roadmap ya BNB — 20,000 TPS, 250ms finality (BEP-670), cyangwa 'AI agent framework' ku rwego rwa chain — zagezweho. Gusa ibyo twipimiye ubwacu.

bnb_latency.a_chain_s_rpc_going_quiet_shows: RPC ya chain iyo yacecetse igaragaza 'reconnecting' kuri iyo nzira gusa; irushanwa risigaye rikomeza gukora. Zose uko ari enye zihagaritse icyarimwe bigaragaza ikosa ryateguwe rifite uburyo bwo kongera kugerageza, ntabwo ari page y'ubusa.
bnb_latency.each_card_samples_real_blocks_or_slots: Buri karita ipima blocks nyayo (cyangwa slots, kuri Solana) kuva kuri RPC rusange kandi igatanga raporo y'igihe cy'ikigereranyo cyapimwe — sparkline ni ibipimo 24 bya nyuma biriho, akabari karekare = igipimo cyihuta cyane.
bnb_latency.every_chain_s_public_rpc_is_unreachable: RPC rusange ya buri chain ntishobora kugerwaho ubu — uku ni uguhagarara nyako, ntabwo ari ikosa. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa uzongere ugenzure vuba.
bnb_latency.every_number_comes_from_which_samples_re: Buri mubare ukomoka kuri /api/bnb/latency, ipima blocks nyayo (BNB binyuze muri probeBlockTime, umurimo umwe ushyigikira proof strip ya /bnb hub) kuva kuri RPCs rusange buri uko igenzuwe — nta na kimwe kibarwa mbere cyangwa ngo gishyirwemo mbere.
bnb_latency.four_lanes_one_honest_race_bnb_chain: Inzira enye, irushanwa rimwe ry'ukuri: BNB Chain, Base, Ethereum, na Solana, buri imwe ipimwa ako kanya kuva kuri RPC rusange buri masegonda make — ntabwo ari '0.45s' yashyizwemo mbere. Inzira yacecetse igaragaza 'reconnecting,' atari umubare w'ikinyoma wahagaze, mu gihe izindi zikomeza kwiruka.

capture.files_stay_on_your_device_decoding_and: Dosye ziguma ku gikoresho cyawe — decoding na rendering bikorera muri browser yawe.
capture.film_a_room_a_street_an_object: Fata amashusho y'icyumba, umuhanda, cyangwa ikintu — hanyuma ubonereho igishushanyo cya 3D cy'ingingo ushobora kugenzura. Geometric Context Transformer ya feed-forward yubaka imiterere yuzuye y'isi ikuye mu mashusho, hanyuma igatambutsa .ply ifite amabara ushobora kuzenguruka hano ako kanya. Usanzwe ufite igishushanyo cya 3D cy'ingingo? Kinjiza cyangwa wandike URL.
capture.frames_stream_through_a_feed_forward_tra: Amashusho atambuka muri feed-forward transformer ihamya coordinates, isoma geometry ifashe, kandi ikosora kwihinduranya muri clip yose — nta optimisation kuri buri shusho. Ibyavuyemo ni point cloud ifite amabara y'isi yose. Ibyo itanga bigaragara na WebGL THREE.Points; iyi ni point cloud, ntabwo ari Gaussian splat.
capture.meta_description: Hindura videwo ya telefoni y'ahantu hose 3D point cloud ishobora kugenzurwa muri browser. Streaming feed-forward reconstruction (LingBot-Map) → .ply ifite amabara, igaragara ako kanya na WebGL.

coin_intel.each_launch_time_signal_s_correlation_wi: Isano rya buri kimenyetso cyo gutangira n'umusaruro mwiza (kwinjira mu cyiciro gikurikira cyangwa kuzamuka cyane), byigishijwe kuri buri faranga ryashyizweho ikimenyetso. Icyatsi kibisi cyerekana abatsinze; umutuku ukerekana abatsinzwe. Nta kintu gihishwe — izi ni isano isanzwe sniper ikoresha mu manota yayo.
coin_intel.every_pump_fun_launch_watched_the_second: Buri gutangira kwa pump.fun, byakurikiranywe ako kanya bigaragara — byashyizwe mu byiciro, bigapimwa ubucuruzi ku bucuruzi, kandi bigahabwa amanota. Gusaba k'umwimerere cyangwa bundle yatewe inkunga? Ni bande bari kugura by'ukuri? Moteri yiga ibimenyetso byerekana abatsinze, n'aba agents bawe ba 3D basoma ubwo bwenge kugira ngo bakore.
coin_intel.every_wallet_that_traded_an_observed_coi: Buri wallet yacuruje ifaranga ryakurikiranywe, yashyizwe mu byiciro hakurikijwe imikoreshereze yayo mu mafaranga atandukanye. Win-rate ni ijanisha ry'amafaranga yaguzwe yinjira mu cyiciro gikurikira cyangwa akazamuka cyane — ribarwa iyo wallet ifite nibura amafaranga 3 yashyizweho ikimenyetso. Iki ni igitabo cy'ubucuruzi inyuma y'igitabo cy'ubucuruzi.

concierge.most_site_chatbots_are_a_text_box: Chatbot nyinshi zo ku mbuga ni agasanduku k'inyandiko gafite ikirango. Iyi yo ni ubuhari: moteri imwe y'avatar yateguwe ikoresha Walk n'ubuyobozi bw'urupapuro, yagenewe ubufasha.
concierge.no_crawler_no_vector_database_no_onboard: Nta crawler, nta database ya vector, nta guhamagara kwa onboarding. Ibice bitatu bigenda.
concierge.one_accent_color_restyles_the_whole_widg: Ibara rimwe ry'ingenzi rihindura imiterere ya widget yose. Amabara yoroheje n'ayijimye akurikira sisitemu y'umusura, cyangwa ugashyiraho rimwe. Munsi ibumoso cyangwa munsi iburyo.
concierge.one_tag_gives_your_site_a_support: Tag imwe iha urubuga rwawe chat y'ubufasha abashyitsi bakunda by'ukuri: avatar ya 3D yateguwe ikabiza, ikavuga, ikanahuza iminwa n'ijwi; ibisubizo bitambuka bishingiye ku rupapuro rwawe ruriho; n'ijwi ryinjira n'irisohoka, biturutse muri browser. Nta konti, nta gushyiraho crawler, nta giciro kuri buri mwanya.
concierge.pick_your_flavor_every_option_ships_the: Hitamo uburyo ukunda. Buri buryo butanga widget imwe.
concierge.push_to_talk_speech_input_and_browser: Kanda uvuge (Push-to-talk) ijwi ryinjira n'ijwi risohoka ry'umwimerere wa browser, nta audio backend na nta API key. Gucecekesha ni ugukanda rimwe kandi biribukwa.
concierge.skeleton_rigged_blinking_idling_viseme_l: Yateguwe na skeleton, ibiza, yicaye, ihuzagurana iminwa n'ijwi mu gihe ivuga. Abashyitsi bahitamo concierge yabo muri kataloge nini, cyangwa ugatanga iyawe bwite GLB.
concierge.the_snapshot_the_running_conversation_an: Ifoto, ikiganiro kiriho, n'ikibazo bijya kuri /api/concierge, ikubaka system prompt ishingiyeho ikanohereza igisubizo binyuze kuri SSE giturutse kuri three.ws free-first inference chain, ifite automatic failover hagati ya providers, kugira ngo widget ikomeze gukora iyo umuhanda umwe ufunzwe.
concierge.the_widget_is_open_source_and_the: Widget ni open source kandi moteri y'ibisubizo iri kuri server ikoresha three.ws free inference chain. Zana endpoint yawe igihe icyo aricyo cyose, format imwe ya wire.
concierge.this_page_runs_it_live_try_the: Uru rupapuro ruyikoresha live, gerageza agapfundikiye kari mu mfuruka ↘
concierge.when_a_visitor_asks_something_the_widget: Iyo umusura abajije ikintu, widget ifata ifoto ya live DOM, umutwe, meta description, imyandikire y'ingenzi, ibirango bya navigation, n'ibiriho by'ingenzi, bigabanyijwe ku ngengo y'imari ikomeye, ikanahuriza hamwe ubumenyi wateguye. Icyo urupapuro rwawe ruvuga uyu munsi nicyo concierge izi uyu munsi.

cookbook_index.the_render_clearly_shows_a_single_styliz: Iyo render yerekana neza igihingwa kimwe cya snake plant cyakozwe mu buryo bwihariye, gifite amababi menshi ahagaze, y'amabara atandukanye, cyatewe mu giseke kigufi cyaboshywe gifite igitambaro imbere — ikintu cyerekanwa kiragaragara kandi gihuye n'insanganyamatsiko y'ibintu byiza, byakozwe n'intoki byegeranywa, nubwo gifite uburyo bworoshye n'imiterere yoroshye.
cookbook_index.the_render_depicts_a_single_triangular_r: Iyo render yerekana ibendera rimwe ry'umutuku rifite ishusho ya mpandeshatu riri ku giti cy'igiti cyashaje gifite imigozi miremire yashaje n'igitambaro cyashaje; nubwo gifite ibimenyetso byoroshye, risomeka neza nk'ibendera rya carnival yo ku nyanja ryashaje kandi rihuye n'insanganyamatsiko ya vintage iteye ubwoba.
cookbook_index.the_render_is_an_indistinct_white_blob: Iyo render ni ikintu cyera kitagaragara neza, nta shusho y'igipupe igaragara, nta masura, nta myenda, cyangwa ikirenge—nta kimenyetso na kimwe cy'umupfumu w'imashini (igitambaro, ijisho, umukondo w'umuringa, ikarita ya tarot) kigaragara, ku buryo ikintu cyerekanwa kidashobora kumenyekana kandi ntigihuye n'insanganyamatsiko.
cookbook_index.the_render_looks_like_a_dark_multi: Iyo render isa n'igiti cy'imikindo/igihingwa cya fern cyijimye, gifite amababi menshi, kiri mu nkono y'ibumba y'igikara ifite imirongo, aho kuba igiti gito cya Monstera: amababi asa n'umutaka afite imikoresho ya radial aho kuba amababi atatu manini, yaka, ya Monstera afite imyenge yoroshye, kandi inkono isomeka nk'igiti cyijimye aho kuba enamel y'umuhondo wa mustard, ku buryo ikintu cyerekanwa kidafite ireme.
cookbook_index.the_render_shows_a_chunky_golden_barrel: Iyo render yerekana umubiri w'igihingwa cya cactus cya golden barrel kinini, ariko inkono ya sima, isahani, n'amabuye yo hejuru birabura—ku buryo kidahuye n'ibisabwa by'igihingwa cyatewe mu nkono kandi ntigihuye n'insanganyamatsiko yashyizweho. Iyo cactus kandi isa n'ifite amahwa menshi cyane kandi idahuye n'ahantu yatewe hagaragara.
cookbook_index.the_render_shows_a_small_ornate_carousel: Iyo render yerekana urubaho ruto rwa carousel rwiza n'igicucu ariko nta farashi yonyine — ikintu cyerekanwa ni imiterere ya carousel aho kuba ifarashi imwe ya carousel yuzuyeho ibikoko byo mu nyanja, ku buryo uyireba atashobora kumenya ikintu cyagenewe. Kandi ibura ibimenyetso byo mu nyanja (ibikoko byo mu nyanja, ibyatsi byo mu nyanja, ijisho ryaka) byasobanuwe mu butumwa.

cookbook_index.the_tool_s_output_is_generative_and: Ibyo igikoresho gisohora ni generative kandi bishobora kubura utabimenye (3D, amashusho, imbonerahamwe, UI code).

demos_audio2face.audio2face_3d_facial_animation: Audio2Face-3D · guhindura isura mu buryo bwa 3D
demos_audio2face.meta_description: Andika inyandiko, uyumve mu ijwi rya NVIDIA Magpie, maze urebe isura ya avatar ya 3D ihinduka ako kanya — ikorwa intambwe ku yindi na NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D. Blendshapes za ARKit nyazo, zikoreshwa kuri rig iyo ari yo yose.
demos_audio2face.meta_og_description: Ijwi rya NVIDIA Magpie + guhindura isura na NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, bihuje, mu mushakisha. Imyanya y'iminwa ya avatar ikurikira amajwi nyayo.
demos_audio2face.meta_og_title: Audio2Face · imiterere ibiri ya NVIDIA ku isura imwe · three.ws
demos_audio2face.meta_title: Audio2Face · imiterere ibiri ya NVIDIA ku isura imwe · three.ws
demos_audio2face.meta_twitter_description: Ijwi rya NVIDIA Magpie + guhindura isura na NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, bihuje, mu mushakisha.
demos_audio2face.meta_twitter_title: Audio2Face · imiterere ibiri ya NVIDIA ku isura imwe · three.ws
demos_audio2face.powered_by_nvidia_audio2face_3d_over_nvc: Ikoreshwa na /api/a2f (NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D binyuze kuri NVCF gRPC) na /api/tts/speak (NVIDIA Magpie). Ihuza rya blendshape na morph riherereye muri src/voice/a2f-player.js — rikoresha amagambo ya ARKit/VRM/Oculus muri src/voice/arkit-blendshapes.js, bityo rig iyo ari yo yose y'umuntu ishobora gukora lip-sync nta rutonde rwihariye rwa buri rig. Reba demo ya lipsync ikoresha amplitude gusa kugira ngo ubone uburyo bwo gusimbura.
demos_audio2face.two_nvidia_models_on_one_face: Imiterere ibiri ya NVIDIA ku isura imwe
demos_audio2face.type_a_line_it_s_spoken_in: Andika interuro. Ivugwa mu ijwi rya NVIDIA Magpie, kandi iryo jwi ryoherezwa kuri NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, igarura ARKit blendshape track kuri buri frame. Umunwa n'isura bya avatar bigenda frame kuri frame n'ijwi nyaryo — bihuye n'uburyo bwa morph-target bwose GLB ikoresha (ARKit, common avatar-platform, VRM, Oculus visemes). Niba Audio2Face idahari, avatar iracyavuga kandi igakoresha amplitude lipsync — ntabwo isura ihagarara.

demos_avatar_sdk.the_npm_sdk_bundle_loaded_from_what: npm SDK bundle yashyizwemo ivuye kuri /avatar-sdk/dist/index.mjs (ibyo abakoresha babona bakoze npm install @three-ws/avatar nimara gusohoka). Iyo yashyizweho, yandika <agent-3d> nka custom element. Igice cya Creator gifungura iframe modal igarura GLB Blob — uburyo bumwe n'ubwo imbuga z'abandi zakoresha.
demos_avatar_sdk.the_sdk_resolves_against_on_the_same: SDK ikemura avatar-id ikoresheje GET /api/avatars/:id kuva aho SDK yashyizwemo (bishobora guhindurwa na api-base="https://other.host"]). Uku ni ugutanga gukomeye gallery picker itanga, kandi bikomeza gukora kabone n'iyo URL ya GLB y'ibanze ihindutse.

demos_bonding_curve.interactive_bancor_v1_simulator_the_same: Simulator ya Bancor V1 ikorana (formula imwe pump.fun ikoresha). Byose bikorera muri browser — nta wallet, nta kwandika kuri blockchain, nta RPC. Koresha sliders, simula kugura no kugurisha ukoresheje ububiko bwa virtual, urebe uko igiciro cy'ako kanya kigenda. Bifasha kumenya ingano ya reserve ratio na graduation threshold mbere yo gushyira hanze agent tokens nyazo.
demos_bonding_curve.same_starting_state_same_cumulative_eth_: Uburyo bumwe bwo gutangira, ETH imwe yose yashyizwemo — ibipimo bitatu bitandukanye by'ububiko. Igipimo gito = curve ikomeye = kumenya igiciro vuba + inyungu nyinshi ku bafata iya mbere. Pump.fun itanga ~25% by default.

demos_brain.meta_description: Ahantu ho gukina na AI ifite models nyinshi. Ganira na Claude, GPT, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek — hindura models hagati y'ikiganiro, gereranya ukurikiranya, unamenye umuvuduko n'ibipimo bya tokens.
demos_brain.meta_og_description: Ahantu ho gukina na AI ifite models nyinshi. Ganira, gereranya, unagerageze models 10 ukurikiranya hamwe n'ibipimo nyabyo bya streaming na tokens.

demos_checkout.hand_tuned_reactive_lighting_baked_into_: Amatara y'imikorere yihariye yateguwe n'intoki, yinjijwe mu gipira gito kigendanwa. Kimwe kuri buri agent.

demos_create_v2.drop_any_gltf_2_0_file_works: Shyiramo dosiye iyo ari yo yose ya glTF 2.0 .glb. Ikora na Blender, Unity, cyangwa ibyo byose byoherejwe na software ya 3D.

Iyi demo ikorera kuri Base Sepolia (testnet, chainId 84532) kandi ivugana na kontaro ya Ethereum Attestation Service kuri 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000021. Nta backend, nta makiyi abitswe — usinya buri kwandika wenyine.

demos_halfbody_xr.side_by_side_preview_of_full_body: Kureba iruhande n'uruhande umubiri wose ugereranije n'igice cy'umubiri. Kureba igice cy'umubiri bigerwaho mu gihe bikoreshwa hagenzurwa amagufwa yo hasi mu gishushanyo mbonera cya GLB (ukuguru, ikibero, ikirenge, ino, n'ibindi) no kubigabanya kugeza kuri zeru — mesh imwe yambaye uruhu, amagufwa yagabanutse kugera ku mwanya wo kuruhuka. Gusubiza mu buryo busanzwe ni ugukora scale write imwe. Injira muri WebXR unyuze kuri iyi page kugira ngo urebe uburyo bwa half-body muri headset.

demos_index.a_3d_avatar_runs_up_and_leaps: Avatar ya 3D irahaguruka ikasimbukira kuri buto nyayo. Imbaraga za spring zikanda kandi zigatuma buto isimbuka iyo ikozweho, hanyuma uruhererekane rugasubiramo.

demos_index.buy_and_sell_along_a_constant_product: Gura no kugurisha ukurikije igishushanyo mbonera cy'igicuruzwa gihoraho. Igiciro, ububiko, n'itandukaniro ry'igiciro bihinduka ako kanya uko ugerageza gukora ubucuruzi.

demos_index.drop_in_web_component_loaded_from_the: Igice cya web <agent-3d> cyinjizwa byoroshye cyapakiwe muri npm SDK bundle, hamwe na iframe ya AvatarCreator ikorana na porogaramu.
demos_index.feed_live_mic_audio_through_the_viseme: Injiza amajwi ya mikoro mu buryo bwa live unyuze mu kisesengura cya viseme, urebe uko akanwa k'ishusho gakurikira ijwi ryawe ako kanya.
demos_index.fourteen_prototypes_for_how_a_3d_agent: Prototypes cumi n'enye zerekana uburyo agent ya 3D ishobora kugaragara ku rupapuro: ikurikira umukono, buto ya trampoline, umupira usenya, kuzamuka umutwe, n'ibindi.

demos_index.live_read_of_on_chain_agent_identities: Soma ako kanya indangamuntu za agent ziri kuri blockchain kuri Base, Ethereum, Polygon, na testnets binyuze muri agent0-sdk. Nta funguzo, nta musinya.

Buri kintu kuri aya mapaji gikoresha APIs nyazo n'ububiko nyabwo — nta by'ikigereranyo.
demos_index.react_wrapper_around_the_avatar_sdk_drop: React wrapper ikikije avatar SDK. Injiza <Agent3D /> muri JSX tree iyo ari yo yose maze ushyiremo props za clip, persona, na camera.

demos_index.send_the_same_prompt_to_claude_gpt: Ohereza prompt imwe kuri Claude, GPT, Qwen kuri Alibaba DashScope, Qwen3-Coder kuri ModelScope, na Llama kuri Groq. Streaming yegeranye, latency, n'ikoreshwa rya token.

docs_walk_chrome_extension.everything_stays_on_your_device_except_t: Byose biguma ku gikoresho cyawe uretse ibyifuzo bya text-to-speech, byoherezwa kuri three.ws kugira ngo bikore amajwi. Amategeko y'urubuga rwawe n'ibyo ukunda bibikwa muri Chrome's synced storage.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.fetch_your_avatars_featured_avatars_and_: Kuzana avatari zawe, avatari zigaragajwe, n'amajwi ya TTS, no gutanga iframe ya walking.

docs_walk_chrome_extension.keep_the_avatar_in_sync_as_you: Guma avatar iri mu buryo bumwe uko unyura mu rubuga, gusuzuma amategeko y'urubuga rwawe, no kugeza impinduka z'amasetingi ako kanya kuri tabu zashyizwemo.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.light_dark_or_auto_samples_the_page: Umucyo, Umunyenga, cyangwa Auto (ifata ibara ry'inyuma rya paji).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.meta_description: Iyongeragerezo rya Chrome rya three.ws Walk Avatar: rigendana na avatar yawe kuri buri rubuga, ugashyiraho uko igaragara n'amategeko kuri buri rubuga, kandi rugasoma amapaji hejuru hakoreshejwe text-to-speech. Uko urishyira, uburenganzira, n'imiterere.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.meta_title: Iyongeragerezo rya Chrome — Inyandiko za Walk — three.ws
docs_walk_chrome_extension.mounts_your_avatar_on_any_site_the: Ishyira avatar yawe kuri buri rubuga. Avatar ni ya iframe itagaragara ya /walk-embed, ishyirwa muri tab irimo gukoreshwa iyo uyifunguye.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.narration_on_off_off_by_default: Gusoma hejuru gufunguye/gufunze (bifunze mu buryo busanzwe).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.persist_your_chosen_avatar_walk_speed_po: Ifata avatar wahisemo, umuvuduko wo kugenda, aho iherereye, amategeko y'urubuga, n'imiterere yo gusoma hejuru (bihuzwa n'ibikoresho byawe bya Chrome).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.picked_from_the_three_ws_tts_voice: Yahiswemo mu rutonde rw'amajwi ya TTS ya three.ws.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.read_the_current_tab_s_hostname_to: Soma hostname ya tab irimo gukoreshwa kugira ngo yandike "Koresha kuri uru rubuga" kandi ihererekanye gufungura/gufunga kwawe kuri iyo tab.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.reads_pages_aloud_optional_with_narratio: Isoma amapaji hejuru (bihitamo). Iyo gusoma hejuru gufunguye, ibona ingingo nyamukuru, ikurikirana ibigaragara, kandi ikavuga ibice bigaragara ikoresheje text-to-speech.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.requires_chrome_109_or_newer_manifest_v3: Bisaba Chrome 109 cyangwa iyisumbuye (Manifest V3). Kugira ngo upfunyike zip yiteguye gushyirwa kuri store, koresha npm run build:extension:prod, bigatanga dist/extension-<version>.zip.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.respects_your_rules_per_site_enabling_pl: Yubahiriza amategeko yawe. Gufungura kuri buri rubuga hamwe na allowlist/blocklist, kandi ntabwo yishyiramo ubwayo — ikora gusa aho wayisabye.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.small_medium_large_or_custom_width_heigh: Ntoya, Hagati, Nini, cyangwa ubugari × uburebure bwihariye.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_is_built_from_this_reposit: Iyongeragerezo ryubatswe kuri iyi repository kandi ryashyizwemo ridapfunyitse. (Ryateguwe kuri Chrome Web Store; ntirirashyirwa ahagaragara, bityo rishyiremo mu buryo bwa developer.)
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_requests_the_minimum_it_ne: Iyongeragerezo risaba ibikenewe byibuze kandi rijyamo gusa iyo umukoresha abisabye neza.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_three_ws_walk_avatar_extension_v1: Iyongeragerezo rya three.ws Walk Avatar (v1.0.0) rishyira avatar ya 3D igenda kuri buri rubuga usura. Rigendana nawe kandi rishobora gusoma ibice by'urupapuro hejuru — umugenzi wawe mu gushakisha. Rikora gusa kuri tab wafunguye neza.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.walk_speed_a_slider_from_0_5: Umuvuduko wo kugenda — akanyerezo kuva kuri 0.5× kugeza 2.0×.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.with_narration_on_the_extension_parses_t: Iyo kuvuga byacanzwe, extension isesengura ingingo nyamukuru y'urubuga (ikoresheje Readability extractor yayo), ikuramo imitwe, interuro, ibintu byo ku rutonde, n'imvugo zishyizwe mu migongo, ikanareba igice kiri kugaragara. Iyo igice kimwe kibaye cyo kwibandwaho, gisaba amajwi yo kuvuga kuri serivisi ya three.ws yo guhindura inyandiko ijwi, kikayacuranga, mu gihe ibwira avatar kugaragaza agapfundikiye k'amagambo no guhindura imyifatire yo gutegereza. Uhora ijwi, ushobora gucecekesha uri hagati mu gusoma, kandi kuvuga kubahiriza prefers-reduced-motion. Abanditsi bashobora kugaragaza ibice bakoresheje data-walk-narrate (cyangwa bakabireka bakoresheje data-walk-narrate="skip").

docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_a_three_ws_site: Uburyo bwa Companion ni ikintu cya three.ws-site. Kugira ngo ushyire avatar igenda ku rubuga rwawe, koresha JavaScript SDK ifite tag imwe; kugira ngo avatar yawe igende kuri buri rubuga rwose usura, shyiramo Chrome extension.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_platform_integrati: Uburyo bwa Companion ni ihuriro rya platform na SDK ya walk ishobora gutangazwa. Imiyoboro ya three.ws ishyiramo script ya companion gusa iyo companion yashyizweho — urupapuro rutayicanye ntiruyishyurira. Mu by'ukuri, itwara manifest y'amashusho ya avatar yateguwe mbere na moteri imwe yo kugaragaza ikoreshwa n'urupapuro rwa walk na embeds.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_site_wide_walking: Uburyo bwa Companion ni avatar igenda ku rubuga rwose rwa three.ws. Buyicane maze avatar yawe ive ku rupapuro, igende kuri ecran, ikugereho uko ugenda uhindura amapaji — irimo n'impinduka z'amapaji zimenya kugenda.
docs_walk_companion_mode.detaches_and_roams_your_avatar_leaves_th: Irava ku rubuga ikazenguruka. Avatar yawe iva ku buryo urupapuro rumeze ikaba umuntu wa 3D wigenga ushobora kureba agenda.
docs_walk_companion_mode.edit_this_page_on_github: ✎ Hindura uru rupapuro kuri GitHub
docs_walk_companion_mode.follows_you_between_pages_when_you_navig: Igukurikira hagati y'amapaji. Iyo uhinduye urupapuro, companion irakomeza — kandi impinduka z'amapaji zimenya kugenda zihindura uko usimbuka kugira ngo bijyane n'aho ugiye.
docs_walk_companion_mode.meta_description: Uburyo bwa Companion: avatar ya three.ws ikwirakwira urubuga rwose, iva ku rupapuro, ikazenguruka, ikagukurikira hagati y'amapaji — irimo impinduka z'amapaji zimenya kugenda no gusezera / gusuhuza.
docs_walk_companion_mode.meta_title: Uburyo bwa Companion — Inyandiko za Walk — three.ws
docs_walk_companion_mode.nav_button_the_walk_control_in_the: Akabuto ka Nav — akabuto ka Walk kari hejuru mu miyoboro gacana cyangwa kagacana companion. Ibyo wahisemo biribukwa buri gihe usuye.
docs_walk_companion_mode.picks_an_avatar_the_picker_includes_a: Hitamo avatar. Uburyo bwo guhitamo burimo umurongo wa "kora iyawe" ujya muri avatar studio.
docs_walk_companion_mode.programmatically_the_companion_instance_: Mu buryo bwa porogaramu — urugero rwa companion ruboneka kuri window.__walkCompanion iyo rwamaze gucanwa (ubu ni uburyo imiyoboro ikoresha).
docs_walk_companion_mode.query_parameter_append_to_any_three_ws: Parametre y'ibibazo — ongeraho ?walk=1 kuri URL iyo ari yo yose ya three.ws kugira ngo biyihate gukora, cyangwa ?walk=0 kugira ngo biyihate guhagarara.
docs_walk_companion_mode.the_companion_and_its_page_transitions_r: Umugenzi n'impinduka z'amapaji ye byubahiriza prefers-reduced-motion. Avatar igenda ni umutako; uburyo bwose bwo kugenda n'ibiriho bikomeza gukoreshwa neza umugenzi adahari, ibyo bikaba ari byo biba bisanzwe kugeza igihe ubishakiye.
docs_walk_companion_mode.waves_goodbye_and_hello_on_a_link: Gusezera no gusuhuza. Iyo ukanze kuri link, avatar ikora ikimenyetso cyo gusezera kandi igashyiraho ikimenyetso kimwe ipaji y'aho igana isoma kugira ngo nayo isuhuze iyo imaze gupakira.

Icyashyizwemo kiza gifite frame-ancestors * kugira ngo gishobore gushyirwa kuri urubuga urwo arirwo rwose, bityo ibyinjira byose byemewe ku busanzwe. Gishimangire ukoresheje ?allowOrigins=https://your.site (na ?targetOrigin= kugira ngo ushimangire aho ibyabaye byoherezwa) iyo uzi neza host.

docs_walk_embed_api.source_is_the_real_authentication_the_if: Inkomoko ni yo kwemeza nyako. Iframe yakira gusa amategeko aturuka ku idirishya ry'umubyeyi wayo; SDK yakira gusa ibyabaye biturutse kuri iframe yikoreye. Inkomoko z'ibinyoma ntizishobora kwinjiza uburyo ubwo aribwo bwose.
docs_walk_embed_api.speed_a_walk_speed_multiplier_clamped_to: Umuvuduko (config.speed): ikigipimo cyongera umuvuduko wo kugenda, gifungiye hagati ya 0.3…3.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_accepted_values_for_the_enumerated_p: Agaciro kemewe ku bice bya payload byashyizwe mu rutonde:
docs_walk_embed_api.the_avatar_moves_throttled_to_10_hz: Avatar iragenda. Yagabanyirijwe umuvuduko kuri ≤ 10 Hz; heading ni icyerekezo cyo guhindukira mu ma radians.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_avatar_starts_speaking_is_how_long: Avatar itangira kuvuga. durationMs ni igihe bubble igumaho.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_embed_emits_these_as_you_drive: Embed itanga ibi uko uyiyobora n'uko avatar ibaho ubuzima bwayo. Iyandikishe ukoresheje avatar.on(name, cb); callback yakira object y'ubutumwa.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_same_integration_in_three_flavours_a: Uburyo bumwe bwo guhuza mu buryo butatu butandukanye. Bose uko ari batatu bakoresha SDK idafite dependencies.
docs_walk_embed_api.the_walking_avatar_embed_is_programmable: Embed ya avatar igenda irashobora gutegurwa. Shyira iframe ya /walk-embed kuri page iyo ari yo yose maze uyiyobore ukoresheje amasezerano ya postMessage yanditseho, y'impande zombi — cyangwa ureke burundu uburyo bwa wire maze ukoreshe SDK ya ThreeWalkAvatar. Iyi page ni yo yuzuyeho amakuru: buri kintu cyose cyabaye, uburyo bw'umutekano, ahantu ho kugeragereza live, n'ingero zo gukoporora no gushyiramo.
docs_walk_embed_api.walks_to_the_point_then_stops_clamped: a.goto(x, z) — igenda ikagera ku ngingo hanyuma igahagarara (ifungiye ku gice cy'ubutaka cyizengurutse).
docs_walk_embed_api.world_bounds_targets_are_clamped_to_a: Imipaka y'Isi: ibyo goto bigamije bifungiye ku ntera ya ~11.5 m (igice cy'ubutaka cyizengurutse).

eth_vanity.grind_a_vanity_smart_contract_address_by: Shakisha aderesi ya smart-contract ya vanity ushakisha CREATE2 salts — nta private keys zikoreshwa. evm_wallet.grind_a_real_ethereum_evm_wallet_whose: Shakisha wallet nyayo ya Ethereum / EVM ifite aderesi itangira cyangwa irangira n'inyuguti wahisemo — ku mukozi wawe, ububiko, cyangwa ahantu hose aderesi ya 0x yoroshye kwibukwa ifite agaciro. Ibisubizo ni keypair isanzwe ya secp256k1 ushobora kwinjiza muri MetaMask, ethers, viem cyangwa Rabby. Ikora yose muri browser yawe. Private key ntabwo yoherezwa ahantu na hamwe.
evm_wallet.hex_characters_only_0_9_a_f: Inyuguti za Hex gusa (0–9, a–f). Buri nyuguti yiyongereye irushya inshuro 16. Inyuguti zivanzemo (urugero BeeF) zihura na EIP-55 checksum — zigaragara neza, zirushya inshuro ~2 kuri buri nyuguti.
evm_wallet.meta_description: Shakisha aderesi ya wallet ya Ethereum / EVM yihariye ifite umugabane w'imbere cyangwa uw'inyuma wahisemo. Ni keypair nyayo ya secp256k1 — ishobora kwinjizwa muri MetaMask, ethers, viem. Ikora yose muri browser yawe; private key ntabwo isohoka mu gikoresho cyawe.
evm_wallet.meta_og_description: Shakisha aderesi ya wallet ya Ethereum / EVM yihariye muri browser yawe. Ni keypair nyayo, ishobora kwinjizwa muri MetaMask. Keys ntabwo zisohoka mu gikoresho cyawe.
evm_wallet.meta_twitter_description: Shakisha aderesi ya wallet ya Ethereum / EVM yihariye muri browser yawe. Keys ntabwo zisohoka mu gikoresho cyawe.
evm_wallet.this_is_an_eoa_grinder_it_searches: Iki ni igikoresho cyo gushakisha EOA — gishakisha imfunguzo bwite mu buryo bweruye, bityo ukaba nyir'ubusobanuro buvuyemo. (CREATE2 ni igikoresho gisa nacyo cyo gushakisha ubusobanuro bwa smart-contract bwihariye, aho ushakisha "salt" aho kuba urufunguzo.) Imfunguzo ziremaremwa na CSPRNG ya mushakisha yawe, buri gihuye kigashakishwa bundi bushya kikanagenzurwa mbere y'uko kigaragazwa, kandi ibyoherejwe hepfo ni "keystore" yashyizwemo urufunguzo mu buryo busanzwe.

fact_check.meta_description: Gusuzuma ukuri bifite inkomoko n'ibimenyetso bya cryptographic bigenzurika. Gushakisha ako kanya + imyanzuro ya LLM, igereranyo ry'ukuri ryasohotse, n'uburyo bwo kugenzura ubuntu buri munsi — gerageza kugenzura nyako hano.
fact_check.meta_og_description: Tanga ikirego, ubone umwanzuro ufite inkomoko n'ikimenyetso cya SHA-256 — bishyigikiwe n'igereranyo ry'ukuri rya rubanda, rigenzurika. Kugenzura 3 ku buntu ku munsi kuri IP imwe, hanyuma $0.10 USDC binyuze kuri x402.

features.a_suite_of_demos_showing_ibm_granite: Urukurikirane rw'imyiyerekano igaragaza imiterere ya IBM Granite — guteganya ibizaba mu gihe runaka, gushushanya agent isobanura ibintu, imiyoborere ya AI, n'ibimenyetso by'ibyemezo bya AI kuri blockchain — byose byagaragajwe muri 3D.
features.ai_brain_any_llm: Ubwonko bwa AI (LLM iyo ari yo yose)
features.ar_feature_details: Amakuru arambuye y'imiterere ya AR →
features.author_your_own_in_the_animation_studio: Andika ibyawe muri Studio y'Animasiyo →
features.combine_a_3d_avatar_with_an_llm: Huza avatar ya 3D n'ubwonko bwa LLM, ijwi, n'imiterere mu agent imwe — yiteguye kuganira, gusubiza ibibazo, no gukora ibikorwa.
features.describe_a_character_in_plain_english_or: Sobanura imiterere mu Cyongereza gisanzwe, cyangwa ushyireho amafoto y'ikintu nyacyo. Forge itanga imiterere ya 3D ifite ibara ku mashini zicunga ubwazo, buri kintu cyose cyasohotse kikabikwa muri gallery.
features.drive_your_avatar_around_a_3d_scene: Yobora avatar yawe mu gice cya 3D ukoresheje WASD cyangwa joystick ikorana n'intoki. Hindura uburyo bwa kamera y'inyuma maze avatar yawe igende mu bidukikije nyabyo.
features.earns_usdc_pay_per_call: Injiza: USDC · kwishyura kuri buri hamagarwa
features.every_avatar_and_forge_model_has_a: Buri avatar na model ya Forge ifite buto ya "Reba muri AR". Kuri telefone, ifatisha model ku buso nyabwo ikoresheje kamera. Kuri mudasobwa, kode ya QR igufasha gusikana no kuyishyira ahantu mu gukanda rimwe. Nta app ikenewe.
features.every_move_live_in_your_browser: Buri gikorwa, ako kanya mu mushakisha wawe.
features.follow_along_for_builds_demos_and_conver: Kurikira ibikorwa byo kubaka, imyiyerekano, n'ibiganiro n'ikipe.
features.for_anyone_running_one_or_more_agents: Ku: muntu wese ukoresha agent imwe cyangwa nyinshi ushaka urubaho rumwe rwo kugenzura aho kuba iminyururu myinshi itatanye.
features.for_anyone_who_wants_to_experience_their: Ku: muntu wese ushaka kureba avatar ye mu buzima busanzwe, cyangwa kwerekana agent mu gikorwa.
features.for_anyone_who_wants_to_see_their: Ku: muntu wese ushaka kureba agent ye ya 3D ku rugero nyarwo — ku meza ye, hasi, cyangwa ku isahani.
features.for_builders_curious_about_autonomous_ag: Ku: bafite ubuhanga bashishikajwe n'ubukungu bwa agent zigenga, cyangwa umuntu wese ushaka gutanga serivisi izishyurwa n'izindi sisitemu za AI.
features.for_builders_who_need_original_3d_charac: Ku: bafite ubuhanga bakeneye imiterere ya 3D yihariye vuba, nta Blender.
features.for_builders_who_want_their_agent_to: Ku: bafite ubuhanga bashaka ko agent yabo yimukanwa, yoherezwa, kandi iboneka n'izindi sisitemu za AI.
features.for_creators_who_have_built_something_us: Ku: baremyi bubatse ikintu cy'ingirakamaro kandi bashaka kukigurisha nta kubaka ibikorwa remezo byo kwishyura.
features.for_creators_who_want_a_community_and: Ku: baremyi bashaka umuryango n'isoko rikorana rizunguruka agent yabo.
features.for_creators_who_want_a_personal_avatar: Ku: baremyi bashaka avatar yabo bwite nta guha akazi umuhanzi wa 3D.
features.for_crypto_enthusiasts_who_want_a_more: Ku: bakunda crypto bashaka uburyo bugaragara bwo gukurikirana isoko.
features.for_developers_and_creators_who_want_a: Ku: bateza imbere n'abaremyi bashaka AI iganira ifite isura igaragara neza.
features.for_enterprise_teams_evaluating_ibm_wats: Ku: makipe y'ibigo binini asuzuma IBM watsonx, cyangwa abateza imbere bashaka kureba ibyo models za Granite zishobora gukora mu bidukikije bya 3D bikorana.
features.for_site_owners_who_want_a_3d: Ku: bafite imbuga bashaka umufasha wa AI wa 3D ku rubuga rwabo nta gukora ku kodingi ya backend.
features.free_to_start_no_credit_card_required: Gutangira ni ubuntu. Nta karita yo kwishyura ikenewe.
features.get_updates_on_new_features_agent_toolin: Bona amakuru mashya ku biranga bishya, ibikoresho bya agent, n'impinduka za protocole.
features.give_your_agent_a_community_token_in: Ha agent yawe token y'umuryango mu byiciro bike — shyiraho izina n'ishusho, kandi ihita itangira gukorana ku isoko rya bonding-curve rya pump.fun umuntu wese ashobora gucururizaho.
features.list_your_agent_s_skills_for_others: Andika ubuhanga bwa agent yawe kugira ngo abandi babugure. Buri guhamagara kwishyurwa muri USDC (idolari rya digital rya $1) binyuze mu kwishyura buri guhamagara — ubwishyu bujya ako kanya mu gikapu cyawe.
features.make_avatars_build_ai_agents_and_put: Kora avatar, ubake agent za AI, kandi uzishyire ahantu hose. Gutangira ni ubuntu, nta gikapu gikenewe.
features.meta_description: Buri kintu cya three.ws cyose hamwe: rema avatar za 3D, shyira abagenzi ku rubuga urwo arirwo rwose, shaka isi z'ibiceri, kandi winjize ukoresheje ubuhanga bwo kwishyura kuri buri guhamagara.
features.meta_og_description: Rema avatar za 3D, shyira abagenzi ahantu hose, shaka isi z'ibiceri, kandi winjize ukoresheje ubuhanga bwo kwishyura kuri buri guhamagara.
features.meta_twitter_description: Rema avatar za 3D, shyira abagenzi ahantu hose, shaka isi z'ibiceri, kandi winjize ukoresheje ubuhanga bwo kwishyura kuri buri guhamagara.
features.no_crypto_needed_everything_in_this_sect: Nta crypto ikenewe. Buri kintu muri iki gice gikora ukoresheje imeyili gusa — nta kofi, nta bimenyetso, nta blockchain. Iyandikishe utangire mu minota mike.
features.one_home_for_everything_you_have_made: Ahantu hamwe ho kubika ibyo wakoze byose — hindura imyitwarire ya buri mugenzi, uhindure animasiyo zayo, ukope kode zo gushyiramo, kandi urebe ibiganiro biza ako kanya.
features.one_transaction_on_solana_gives_your_age: Kugurisha kumwe kuri Solana guha umugenzi wawe indangamuntu ihoraho, ishobora kugenzurwa — umutungo wa Metaplex Core ushobora kuboneka kandi ukizewe na buri mukiriya wa A2A cyangwa MCP.
features.pick_a_goal_start_in_five_minutes: Hitamo intego. Tangira mu minota itanu.
features.pick_an_avatar_configure_size_and_style: Hitamo avatar, uhindure ingano n'imiterere, hanyuma ukope akamenyetso kamwe ka script. Kagishyire muri Notion, Ghost, WordPress, Framer — ahantu hose.
features.pick_any_animation_below_your_avatar_swi: Hitamo animasiyo iyo ari yo yose hepfo. Avatar yawe ihinduka ako kanya — nta kongera gupakurura urupapuro, nta kwinjiza. Ibi bikora kuri buri gikoresho, muri buri gushyiramo.
features.put_agents_on_chain_charge_for_what: Shyira abagenzi kuri chain, wishyurire ibyo bakora, kandi ushyireho token. Bifite imbaraga, ariko ntibisabwa na rimwe.
features.reads_live_market_prices_on_chain: Soma ibiciro by'isoko by'ako kanya kuri chain.
features.start_free_add_crypto_only_if_you:
Tangira ubuntu.
Ongeramo crypto gusa niba ubishaka.
features.take_one_photo_and_get_back_a: Fata ifoto imwe kandi ubonereho avatar ya 3D yuzuye mu masegonda agera kuri 60.
features.the_latest_features_each_linked_to_the: Ibiranga bishya n'ibyatangijwe vuba, buri kimwe gifitanye isano n'urupapuro rw'ako kanya. Urutonde rwihererekanya ubwarwo buri gihe habayeho gusohora.
features.the_web_component_lazy_loads_renders_on: Icyiciro cya web <agent-3d> cyikora buhoro, kigaragara kuri buri gikoresho, kandi gihuzwa na AI stack yawe isanzwe binyuze muri MCP cyangwa A2A. Nta framework. Nta build step.
features.the_whole_product_making_avatars_buildin: Igicuruzwa cyose — gukora avatars, kubaka AI agents, kubishyira ahantu hose — bikora gusa ukoresheje imeri. Ibiranga on-chain biri hepfo ni ibyongeweho ushobora kuzakoresha nyuma.
features.these_features_use_crypto_to_switch_them: Ibi biranga bikoresha crypto. Kugira ngo ubikoreshe, uzaba ukeneye wallet n'amafaranga make ya USDC cyangwa SOL. Nubireka rwose, igicuruzwa cy'ibanze cyavuzwe haruguru kiracyakora neza.
features.walk_your_avatar_through_3d_worlds_tied: Gendana avatar yawe mu isi za 3D zihujwe n'ibiciro bya crypto bihari. Ubutaka buhinduka bitewe n'isoko — buri si ni ubutaka bwa token itandukanye.
features.watch_two_ai_agents_oracle_and_nova: Reba AI agents ebyiri — ORACLE na NOVA — ziganira, zikoresha ubuhanga bwazo, kandi zikishyurana on-chain byikora. Nta bantu babigizemo uruhare.
features.why_it_s_better_agents_in_the: Impamvu ari byiza: Agents mu isi zishyurana on-chain mu gihe nyacyo — ushobora kureba x402 micropayment transactions zibera imbonankubone uko ugenda.
features.why_it_s_better_any_llm_works: Impamvu ari byiza: LLM yose ikora binyuze muri MCP cyangwa A2A — Claude, GPT, Gemini, cyangwa iyawe bwite. Nta vendor lock-in.
features.why_it_s_better_every_avatar_and: Impamvu ari byiza: Buri avatar na agent ukora bigaragara hano byikora — nta kintu cyo guhuza, login imwe kuri byose.
features.why_it_s_better_it_s_a: Impamvu ari byiza: Ni itangizwa nyaryo rifite ubucuruzi bukorwa ako kanya kuva ku isegonda rya mbere — wowe utanga amakuru, twebwe tugakora ibya on-chain.
features.why_it_s_better_no_app_install: Impamvu ari byiza: Nta gushyiramo app — ikorera muri browser ifite physics nyayo (Rapier) n'ubutaka nyabwo, atari ahantu hataringaniye.
features.why_it_s_better_no_sdk_required: Impamvu ari byiza: Nta SDK ikenewe ku ruhande rw'umukoresha — tag imwe, urupapuro urwo arirwo rwose, nta build step.
features.why_it_s_better_outputs_are_glb: Impamvu ari byiza: Ibisohoka byiteguye GLB — bishyire muri viewer ako kanya, ubishyireho, cyangwa ubishyiremo nta gihindura.
features.why_it_s_better_pay_per_call: Impamvu ari byiza: Kwishyura kuri buri guhamagara bivuze ko nta subscriptions zo gucunga — abaguzi bishyura ibyo bakoresheje gusa, nawe ukishyurwa kuri buri guhamagara.
features.why_it_s_better_real_on_chain: Impamvu ari byiza: Kwishyurana nyako on-chain binyuze muri pay-per-call (micropayments) — buri transaction irashobora kugenzurwa, ntabwo ari simulation.
features.why_it_s_better_sub_cent_fees: Impamvu ari byiza: Amafaranga make cyane. Ufite imfunguzo. Ikarita ya agent ni URL ya JSON rusange — nta kintu gifungiye kuri uru rubuga.
features.why_it_s_better_the_rig_is: Impamvu ari byiza: Rig yiteguye animation — ushobora kuyishyira muri viewer ako kanya ugahita ukoresha animation iyo ari yo yose.
features.why_it_s_better_these_are_real: Impamvu ari byiza: Ibi ni Granite API calls nyazo — zitari mocked — buri cyemezo gihujwe na Solana transaction nk'inyandiko idahinduka.
features.why_it_s_better_three_ar_methods: Impamvu ari byiza: Uburyo butatu bwa AR mu buto bumwe — iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, na WebXR. Ibukwiye ikora yonyine. Agent iguma ikora muri WebXR, bityo ibiganiro na animations bikora muri AR.

features_agent_exchange.built_on_the_open_x402_http_payment: Yubatswe kuri standard y'ubwishyu ya HTTP ya x402 ifunguye — umukiriya uwo ari we wese wa HTTP ushyigikira 402 / kwemeza ubwishyu ashobora kuba umuguzi cyangwa umucuruzi muri ubu bukungu.
features_agent_exchange.every_transaction_appears_in_the_live_fe: Buri gikorwa cyose kigaragara muri pane y'amakuru y'ako kanya hamwe na hash ya tx Solana, umubare muri USDC, n'uko byemejwe. Ushobora kugenzura buri gikorwa cyose kuri Solana Explorer wenyine.

features_agent_exchange.neither_agent_is_simulated_both_hold_sol: Nta agent n'imwe yigana. Zombi zifite wallets za Solana zifite USDC nyayo. Buri bwishyu bwose ni igikorwa cyemejwe kuri blockchain — ntabwo ari ikigereranyo cyangwa inyandiko mu gitabo.
features_agent_exchange.nova_s_endpoint_responds_with_a_402: Endpoint ya NOVA isubiza 402 Payment Required n'igiciro cyagenwe. Wallet ya ORACLE yemeza ubwishyu, isinya igikorwa cya Solana, kandi ikongera gusaba — NOVA igenzura iyishyurwa kuri blockchain kandi igasubiza amakuru.
features_agent_exchange.open_the_agent_exchange_and_see_every: Fungura Agent Exchange kandi urebe buri gikorwa cyose kuri blockchain kiba mu gihe nyacyo.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_are_two_ai_agents: ORACLE na NOVA ni aba-agent ba AI babiri bafite avatars za 3D na wallets za Solana nyazo. Bagura kandi bakagurisha ubwenge bwa crypto hagati yabo bigenga banyuze kuri micropayments za x402 — buri gikorwa cyose cyemezwa kuri blockchain, kigaragara mu gihe nyacyo.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_have_distinct_3d_avatars: ORACLE na NOVA zifite avatars za 3D zitandukanye, amajwi, n'indangamuntu kuri blockchain — uzibona nk'ibigo biganira, atari nka API calls zidafite isura.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_decides_it_needs_crypto_market_da: ORACLE ifata icyemezo ko ikeneye amakuru y'isoko rya crypto. Ivumbura NOVA nk'utanga amakuru kuri kataloge ya serivisi ya x402 kandi igasaba API yishyuwe — guhamagara kwa HTTP bisanzwe bifite umutwe w'iyemeza ry'ubwishyu.
features_agent_exchange.the_three_ws_agent_sdk_implements_the: SDK ya agent ya three.ws ishyira mu bikorwa inzira yuzuye ya x402 ako kanya. Agent iyo ari yo yose wubaka ishobora guhamagara ubumenyi bwishyuwe kandi ikinjiza amafaranga mu kugaragaza ubumenyi bwayo — ibikorwa remezo bimwe na bimwe ORACLE na NOVA zikoresha.

features_deploy.every_agent_minted_through_three_ws_carr: Buri agenti wose wacurishijwe binyuze muri three.ws uba ufite ikimenyetso cya "3ws" cy'icuruzwa — ikimenyetso cyemeza inkomoko yacyo, kigihuza n'uru rubuga.
features_deploy.fill_in_your_agent_s_name_description: Shyira izina rya agenti yawe, ibisobanuro, tags z'ubuhanga, n'ishusho mu gice cya Deploy UI. Hujuriza GLB ya 3D ushaka ko icuruzwa kuri blockchain — yaba yaravuye muri Forge, yakanzwe, cyangwa yinjijwe.

features_forge.attach_the_glb_to_any_ai_agent: Hujuriza GLB kuri agenti ya AI iyo ari yo yose kuri three.ws kugira ngo agenti ibone umubiri wa 3D wihariye aho kuba ishusho isanzwe.
features_forge.describe_what_you_want_a_ceramic_coffee: Sobanura icyo ushaka — "igikombe cya kawa cy'ibumba gifite ibara ry'ubururu," "inkota y'icyuma yaguyeho ingese," cyangwa ikindi cyose. Saba neza ibijyanye n'ibikoresho n'imiterere kugira ngo ubone ibyiza.
features_forge.each_generated_model_gets_a_permanent_ur: Buri model yaremwe ibona URL ihoraho ushobora gusangiza abandi — yifungura muri browser iyo ari yo yose nta plugins cyangwa apps zikenewe.
features_forge.every_generated_model_opens_in_webxr_ar: Buri model yaremwe yifungura muri WebXR AR mode ukoresheje gukanda rimwe — ishyire ku meza yawe nyayo cyangwa hasi maze uyizenguruke.
features_forge.flux_renders_a_detailed_texture_image_fr: Flux itanga ishusho irambuye ifite texture ikomoka ku nyandiko yawe. TRELLIS ihindura iyo shusho ikaba 3D mesh yuzuye ifite texture za UV-mapped, byose bikorwa mu buryo bumwe.
features_forge.forge_runs_flux_image_generation_and_tre: Forge ikoresha Flux mu kurema amashusho na TRELLIS mu kongera kubaka 3D bikurikirana. Sobanura ikintu icyo aricyo cyose maze ubonane GLB ifite texture ushobora kuzengurukisha muri AR, kuyishyira ahantu hose, cyangwa kuyihuza n'umukozi wawe wa AI.
features_forge.inspect_the_result_in_the_in_browser: Reba ibyavuyemo mu kurebera muri browser, ukurure GLB, usangize link, cyangwa uyihambire ku mukozi wawe wa AI nk'umubiri wayo wa 3D — byose bikorewe ku rupapuro rumwe.

features_play.your_avatar_spawns_in_a_procedurally_gen: Avatar yawe igaragara mu butaka bwaremwe mu buryo bwa procedural bwakomotse kuri mint ya iyo coin. Buri coin ihuye na biome imwe muri esheshatu — isi ihora ari imwe kuri mint iyo ari yo yose.

features_scan.the_output_is_a_rigged_glb_the: Ibisohoka ni GLB yateguwe — igikanka cyayo cyateguwe ku buryo animations za BVH zisanzwe cyangwa iza Mixamo zikora ako kanya. Kiyipakure, kiyishyiremo, cyangwa utangize agent yawe ukoresheje yo.
features_scan.the_scanner_captures_several_angles_auto: Scanner ifata impande zitandukanye byikora ikazohereza muri pipeline yacu yo kongera kubaka, iyubaka mesh ya 3D yuzuye ifite texture y'uruhu ya UV-mapped.
features_scan.the_skeleton_follows_the_standard_mixamo: Igikanka gikurikiza amategeko asanzwe ya Mixamo humanoid-rig ku buryo ibihumbi bya animation clips z'ubuntu zikora nta kongera kuzitegura.

features_studio.chat_with_your_agent_live_in_the: Ganira na agent yawe ako kanya mu idirishya rya preview. Hindura avatar, ongera utunganye prompt, uhindure ijwi — preview ihita yihindura nta kongera gushyiramo. Gerageza ibibazo bidasanzwe mbere yo kubishyira hanze.

forge.model_failed_to_load_often_a_brief: Model yananiwe gupakira — akenshi biterwa n'ikibazo gito cya internet ku dosiye. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa ukoreshe akabuto ko gukuramo kari hepfo kugira ngo uyibike ako kanya.
forge.multi_engine_pipeline_engines_marked_fre: Uburyo bwa pipeline ikoresha moteri nyinshi. Moteri zanditseho UBUNTU zikora nta funguro: Kurema kwakiriwe na NVIDIA hamwe n'abakozi bacu ba GPU twishyizemo (TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D, TripoSG). Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Stability, na Replicate bikora ku funguro rya API ryawe bwite. Ibisubizo byiza: ikintu kimwe cyasobanuwe neza gifite ibikoresho n'umurongo w'urumuri. Uburyo bw'amafoto bwakira amashusho agera kuri 6 kugira ngo hongere huremwe amashusho menshi. Ubu buryo bwa pipeline buraboneka ku bagize MCP kuri /api/mcp-3d.
forge.no_3d_engine_is_reachable_on_this: Nta moteri ya 3D ishobora kugerwaho kuri iyi deployment. Shyiraho kimwe muri NVIDIA_API_KEY cyangwa HF_TOKEN ku nzira z'ubuntu, cyangwa REPLICATE_API_TOKEN kuri pipeline ya flux → TRELLIS — Forge ikoresha icyo cyashyizweho nta mpinduka zindi.
forge.one_click_geometric_filters_restyle_this: Ibyungurura bya geometrike bikorwa rimwe gusa. Hindura imiterere ya iyi model ikaba voxels, amatafari, urushundura rweruye, cyangwa low-poly — ibara ry'umwimerere rihererekanywa aho uburyo bubyemera.

Ushobora kongera kunoza isura, imyenda, n'imigendekere mu mukoresha nyuma. Uri gukora ikintu, igikoresho, cyangwa igice cy'ahantu aho gukora umuntu? Jya ku gice cya Ikintu hejuru.

forge_studio.multi_engine_pipeline_free_uses_nvidia_h: Pipeline ikoresha moteri nyinshi — Ubuntu ikoresha ibyaremwe na NVIDIA; Fast, Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Stability, na Replicate bisaba API key. Ibyiza byavuyemo: ikintu kimwe gisobanuwe neza gifite ibikoresho n'urumuri. Uburyo bw'amafoto bwemera kureba inshuro 4 kugira ngo hongere hubakwe ibintu bitandukanye. Iyo pipeline imwe iraboneka ku bagenzuzi binyuze kuri MCP kuri /api/mcp-3d.

hero_demo.a_golden_angle_starfield_drifts_slowly_w: Inyenyeri zikwirakwira mu buryo bwa 'golden-angle' zikonjora buhoro mu gihe kamera yegera akamenyetso k'imbaraga za parallax. prefers-reduced-motion yerekana ishusho imwe idahinduka.
hero_demo.a_lit_avatar_centered_in_deep_space: Avatar imurika, iri hagati mu kirere cyimbitse hejuru y'impeta zimurika zizenguruka — urumuri rwinshi (bloom), inyenyeri zikonjora, n'imbaraga za parallax z'akamenyetso. Shyiramo GLB iyo ari yo yose, ihita ikora.
hero_demo.an_over_the_emissive_rings_and_starfield: UnrealBloomPass hejuru y'impeta zimurika n'inyenyeri zikwirakwira itanga hafi 70% by'ubwiza bw'ishusho. Urugero rwo hejuru kugira ngo ibice byaka gusa bibe aribyo bimurika.
hero_demo.five_additive_rings_tilted_into_a_disc: Impeta eshanu za TorusGeometry zongerana, zihinduriwe mu ishusho y'uruziga kandi zihabwa ibara bitewe n'uburyo bw'amabara y'ibanze. Zihumeka kandi zizunguruka mu buryo bunyuranye kugira ngo zitange ubujyakuzimu.

home.01_studio_selfie_to_rigged_avatar_in: 01 Studio Selfie ihinduka avatar yateguwe mu masegonda. Ikora muri browser, yihutishwa na GPU — nta software yo gushyiraho. ↗

home.03_embed_web_component_one_tag_any: 03 Shyiramo Icyiciro cya web cya <agent-3d>. Tag imwe. Host iyo ari yo yose. Ipakirwa buhoro, CSS yihariye, yakiriwe kuri CDN ku rwego rw'isi. ↗
home.04_pay_per_call_http_native_usdc: 04 Wishyura kuri buri guhamagara Ubwishyu buke bwa USDC bukoresha HTTP. Wishyura bitewe n'ubuhanga, ubutumwa, cyangwa igihe cyo gukoresha. Nta kiguzi cy'urubuga (0%) mu gihe cya open beta. ↗
home.05_walk_multiplayer_3d_worlds_crdt_synce: 05 Genda mu isi za 3D zikinirwa n'abantu benshi. Imyanya y'abakinnyi ihuzwa na CRDT, ijwi ry'ahantu, ubugenzuzi bwa joystick — byose mu kintu kimwe cyo gushyiramo. ↗

home.a_full_stack_platform_for_3d_ai: Urubuga rwuzuye rwa 3D AI agents: kuva kuri selfie kugeza kuri agent yasohotse, kuva mu kwinjiza kugeza ku kwinjiza amafaranga.
home.a_live_slice_of_forge_the_same: Agace kagaragara neza ka Forge, uburyo bumwe bwa text-to-3D butanga imbaraga kuri page yose. Sobanura ikintu hanyuma GLB ifite imiterere n'ibara, ishobora gukururwa, ihita ifata ishusho hano, ubusanzwe mu munota umwe. Fungura Amahitamo kugira ngo ubone ubwonko bwuzuye: ibyiciro by'ubwiza, guhitamo moteri ibaho, igipimo cy'ubugari n'uburebure, n'iterambere rya prompt rimwe gusa. Forge yuzuye yongeraho ifoto n'igishushanyo, guhuza amashusho menshi, ibyunguruzo byo guhindura imiterere, na retopology.
home.a_live_slice_of_pose_studio_the: Agace kagaragara neza ka Pose Studio — uburyo bumwe bwo gushyiraho, ibyateguwe, n'ubugenzuzi bw'ingingo. Zenguruka ishusho, kanda ku gice cy'umubiri kugira ngo uyishyire mu mwanya, cyangwa ukande kuri preset kugira ngo uhindure imyanya yose. Hanyuma ukoreshe studio yuzuye ku bijyanye na keyframes, avatars zawe bwite, no kohereza mu buryo bwa PNG/GLB.
home.a_taste_of_what_s_running_across: Akantu k'ibiri gukoreshwa kuri interineti uyu munsi. Kanda kuri agent iyo ari yo yose kugira ngo uvugane, uyihindure, cyangwa ufate code yo kuyishyiramo.

ibm_hello.amounts_are_deliberately_tiny_a_cent_or: Amafaranga ni make cyane (sentire cyangwa munsi yayo), kandi demo za ubuntu — avatari, imyifatire, galaxy, isi, AR — ntizikeneye wallet na gato.
ibm_hello.anchor_a_3d_agent_to_physical_space: Hambira agent ya 3D mu mwanya nyirizina maze uyirebe binyuze kuri kamera yawe, hamwe n'utudomo nyirizina ushyira hafi yawe — uguma ufite ubuyobozi bw'uburenganzira bwose. ibm_hello.describe_a_character_three_ws_generates_: Sobanura umuntu; three.ws ikora mesh ifite texture, yikoresha igikanka, ikagishyira ako kanya muri moteri y'avatar — aho ihagarara, igahumeka, ikanazunguza amaboko. Ubuntu, nta wallet. Rig imwe ya rusange ituma buri kiremwa muntu cyambara animation zacu, ikora ako kanya muri browser yawe.
ibm_hello.draft_0_05_fast_preview_geometry_best: Umushinga$0.05 Geometry yihuse yo kureba mbere. Byiza kugerageza uko bikora. ~40s
ibm_hello.every_agent_carries_portable_identity_an: Buri agent itwara indangamuntu n'icyubahiro byimukanwa kuri chain, hamwe na licenses z'ubuhanga zikozwe nka 1/1 SPL NFTs — uburyo bwo kwinjira bwemejwe nta database mu nzira y'icyizere. Solana + EVM.
ibm_hello.every_avatar_here_is_generated_and_rigge: Buri avatar iri hano ikorwa kandi igashyirwaho rig iyo uyikeneye — nta library ya templates, nta characters zateguwe. Rig ihuza n'igikanka cya three.ws cyemewe, bityo clips zimwe zo guhagarara, kugenda no kwerekana amarangamutima zikina kuri icyo usobanura cyose. Urashaka image→3D, kwinjiza GLB yawe, cyangwa AR preview? Fungura igikoresho cyuzuye cya Forge ↗ Uburyo bw'ubuntu bufite umubare ntarengwa w'amasaha kugira ngo bugume ari ubuntu kuri buri wese; niba buhuze, bukubwira neza igihe cyo kongera kugerageza. Gukora bikoresha NVIDIA NIM kandi byikora mu buryo bwo gusubira inyuma mu nzira zitandukanye, bityo model ihora igaruka.
ibm_hello.every_avatar_three_ws_generates_lands_on: Buri avatar three.ws ikora igwa ku gikanka kimwe cyemewe — bityo rig imwe ikazishyira mu buryo bwose. Zunguruka mannequin, fata urugingo urukoreze (inverse kinematics ku maboko n'ibirenge), kora ku ngingo ukoresheje sliders, cyangwa ukande preset kugira ngo uhindure pose yose. Ni rig nyayo iri inyuma ya Pose Studio yuzuye, ikora ako kanya kuri page.
ibm_hello.every_coin_on_three_ws_is_a: Buri coin kuri three.ws ni umwanya wa 3D agents n'abashyitsi basangira ako kanya — injira, hitamo avatar, unagende mu isi isubiza ibikorwa bya live kuri chain. Hitamo izina n'umubiri hepfo kugira ngo winjire; ikora yuzuye, ako kanya kuri page.
ibm_hello.every_demo_below_runs_against_real_produ: Buri demo iri hepfo ikora kuri sisitemu za three.ws nyazo, zikoreshwa: wishyure make kugira ngo uhindure inyandiko mo model ya 3D, ukore avatar ifite rig uhereye ku nteruro, uyishyire mu buryo n'intoki, uguruke mu kirere cya 3D cy'agents zashushanyijwe na IBM Granite, winjire mu isi isangiwe, cyangwa ushyire agent muri augmented reality. Forge yishyurwa ikoresha USDC nyayo — cyangwa $THREE — ivuye muri wallet yawe; izindi zose ni ubuntu, nta wallet ikenewe. Nta kintu cyigana.
ibm_hello.everything_on_this_page_is_a_live: Buri kintu kuri iyi page ni igice gikora cya platform ikoreshwa: Forge (inyandiko→3D), Pose, ikirere cy'agents zashushanyijwe na Granite, isi za Play, na IRL augmented reality.

ibm_hello.ibm_provides_the_trusted_ai_layer_ibm: IBM itanga urwego rwa AI rwizewe. ibm_hello.the_same_rails_behind_these_demos_3d: Imikorere imwe iri inyuma y'izi demos — gukora 3D, ubwenge bwa Granite, indangamuntu kuri blockchain, n'ubwishyu bwa x402 — irafunguye kugira ngo ubyubakireho. Hitamo urugi.
ibm_hello.the_stream_will_appear_here_the_moment: Stream izagaragara hano mu kanya gato itangiye.
ibm_hello.this_pays_the_same_x402_rail_as: Ibi byishyura imikorere imwe ya x402 nk'iya demo iri hepfo — ubwishyu bumwe buke, muri USDC cyangwa $THREE kuri Solana, bukoresha pipeline nyayo ya text→3D (Microsoft TRELLIS kuri NVIDIA NIM) kandi ikaguha GLB ifite texture ushobora kuzenguruka no gukuramo. Igiciro kiri hepfo gisomwa ako kanya kuri 402 response ya server; hitamo token yawe muri wallet.
ibm_hello.three_is_the_native_coin_of_three: $THREE ni ifaranga kavukire rya three.ws, rikoreshwa mu kwishyura kuri platform hamwe na USDC. Ni ryo faranga ryonyine three.ws itanga. Adiresi ya kontaro: FeMbDoX7R1Psc4GEcvJdsbNbZA3bfztcyDCatJVJpump kuri Solana.
ibm_hello.three_ways_in_by_altitude_drop_the: Uburyo butatu bwo kwinjiramo, bitewe n'urwego. Shyira script y'umurongo umwe x402.js kuri page iyo ari yo yose kugira ngo ikore element ishobora kwishyurwa. Fata imwe muri 18 zero-dependency @three-ws/* SDKs — forge, ijwi, amazina, ubwenge, izina ryiza, x402 — kugira ngo uhamagare API zitaziguye muri code. Cyangwa uhuze 37 MCP servers n'umukozi wa AI kugira ngo ashobore gukora 3D, kwishyura, gucuruza, no kugenzura indangamuntu nk'ibikoresho kavukire.
ibm_hello.three_ws_is_a_platform_for_3d: three.ws ni urubuga rwa AI agents za 3D. Ubusobanura imiterere y'umuntu mu magambo asanzwe ukabona avatar ifite texture, yakorewe rigging, igenda, ifata imyanya, kandi ibaho mu isi za 3D zisangiwe — ikora muri browser iyo ari yo yose, nta gushyiraho software. Buri agent ishobora kugira indangamuntu kuri blockchain, kugira wallet, no kwishyura cyangwa kwishyuza akazi mu gihe nyacyo.
ibm_hello.three_ws_turns_a_sentence_into_a: three.ws ihindura interuro ikayigira 3D agent yakorewe rigging, ikayiha indangamuntu n'ububiko kuri blockchain, ikayiha ubushobozi bwo kwinjiza no gukoresha amafaranga mu gihe nyacyo binyuze kuri x402, kandi igatekereza kuri byose hamwe na IBM Granite kuri watsonx.ai. Demo ziri hepfo ni ibice bigize imashini — iyi ni imashini yose.
ibm_hello.want_image_3d_auto_rigging_ar_preview: Urashaka image→3D, auto-rigging, AR preview n'amafoto yose? Fungura igikoresho cyuzuye cya Forge ↗
ibm_hello.what_does_ibm_bring_to_the_partnership: IBM izana iki muri ubu bufatanye?
ibm_hello.what_is_the_x402_protocol: Ni iki x402 protocol?
ibm_hello.what_three_ws_is_what_ibm_brings: Icyo three.ws ari cyo, icyo IBM izana, n'uburyo ibice bya 3D, AI, na on-chain bihuza.
ibm_hello.x402_revives_the_dormant_http_402_paymen: x402 izura HTTP 402 Payment Required yari yarazimye, ikayigira uburyo nyabwo bwo kwishyura. Uhamagara endpoint nk'ibisanzwe; niba yishyuwe, seriveri igusubiza 402 ikubwira igiciro nyacyo, umutungo, n'aho wohereza. Ikarita yawe isinya uburenganzira budasaba gazi, ukongera ukohereza ukoresheje X-PAYMENT header, maze ihamagara igakemuka kuri on-chain — byose mu rugendo rumwe, nta konti cyangwa API key.
ibm_hello.yes_the_paid_demos_move_real_funds: Yego. Demo zishyuwe zikoresha amafaranga nyayo avuye mu ikarita yawe — USDC, cyangwa $THREE kuri Solana — kandi zigakemuka kuri Base cyangwa Solana mainnet. Nta kigana cyangwa ikigero; igiciro ubona gisomwa ako kanya kuri 402 response ya seriveri, kandi ubona inyemezabuguzi ya on-chain.
ibm_hello.you_can_pay_every_x402_demo_on: Ushobora kwishyura buri demo ya x402 iri kuri iyi paji muri $THREE, cyangwa ukayireba kuri pump.fun.
ibm_hello.you_ll_get_back_price_24_hour: Uzahabwa igiciro, impinduka mu masaha 24, market cap, liquidity, volume y'amasaha 24, n'ikimenyetso gifite impamvu ngufi — byose biturutse kuri DexScreener. Bikemuka muri USDC cyangwa $THREE kuri Solana (USDC kuri Base); ikiguzi cya network gitangwa na facilitator.
ibm_hello.you_ll_need_the_phantom_wallet_on: Uzakeneye ikarita ya Phantom kuri Solana — ifite igiciro cya model muri USDC, cyangwa ikingana nayo muri $THREE, kuri Solana mainnet. Ibi bikoresha amafaranga nyayo — igiciro cyerekanwe hejuru — avuye mu ikarita yawe; ikarita igufasha guhitamo USDC cyangwa $THREE. Kwishyura ubwabyo ni umukono udasaba gazi: ikiguzi cya network gitangwa na x402 facilitator, bityo ntikiyongera ku kiguzi cyawe. Generation itangira kwishyura byemejwe kandi bifata hafi umunota. Nta karita? Forge imwe ku buntu hepfo — nta karita, nta key, nta kwishyura.
ibm_hello.you_sign_a_gasless_usdc_authorization_re: Usinya uburenganzira bwa USDC budasaba gazi, ukongera ukohereza ukoresheje X-PAYMENT header, maze ihamagara igakemuka kuri on-chain — amakuru yawe akagaruka.

irl_privacy.when_on_people_viewing_the_same_area: Iyo bifunguye, abantu bareba ahantu hamwe bakubona nk'ikimenyetso cy'igicucu cy'umuntu kiri ahantu hatari neza. Umubare w'abantu bahari batamenyekana usangizwa uko byagenda kose; aho uherereye neza ntabwo hagera ku bandi.

irl_privacy.while_you_re_using_irl_the_only: Mu gihe ukoresha IRL, ikintu kimwe gusa kigaragara abantu bari hafi ni ukuba uhari utazwi — n'igicucu cyoroheje, niba uhisemo kukigaragaza. Aho uherereye neza ntabwo hava ku gikoresho cyawe.
irl_privacy.who_placed_any_agent_no_account_or: Uwashyizeho umukozi uwo ari we wese — nta konti cyangwa indangamuntu y'igikoresho yigeze ihuzwa.
irl_privacy.your_agents_are_private_by_location: Abakozi bawe ni ibanga bitewe n'aho biherereye.
irl_privacy.your_exact_gps_coordinates_they_stay_on: Aho uherereye neza kuri GPS — biguma ku gikoresho cyawe keretse niba ushyizeho akamenyetso.
irl_privacy.your_placements_remove_anytime: Aho wabishyize — bishobora gukurwaho igihe icyo aricyo cyose.

launch_week.1_010_members_in_the_x_community:
Abanyamuryango 1,010 mu muryango wa X.
Kuva ku busa. Mu cyumweru kimwe.
launch_week.267_8k_impressions_25_3k_engagements_9: Ibigaragaye 267.8K. Ibikorwa 25.3K. Igipimo cy'ibikorwa 9.4%. Abasuye umwirondoro 5.1K. Gukunda 7.2K, ibyasubiwemo 1.5K, ibisubizo 845, ibimenyetso 198, ibyasangijwe 61. Igipimo cy'ibisubizo ku gukunda: 11.7% — cyageze kure mu biganiro bya ako kanya. Abakurikira bemejwe: 359. Bakurikira: 11.
launch_week.a_real_time_3d_agent_runtime_on: Uburyo bwa 3D agent runtime ikora ako kanya kuri Three.js + glTF. Chat y'abafatanyabikorwa benshi (Claude, GPT, Groq, OpenRouter) ifite amarangamutima ashingiye ku byiyumvo. Kwinjiza wallet ya Solana kavukire. Ubumenyi bwo gucuruza bwa Pump.fun nk'ibikoresho bya agent. SDK yose ya pump-fun-agent-payments yarasobanuwe — Anchor IDL, PDAs, gusoma ibyabaye, x402 layer — ubu ni source ishobora guhindurwa. Solana vanity grinder. Pump.fun umufatanyemikono mu kurema ibiceri. Live pump.fun feed.
launch_week.anthropic_claude_openai_gpt_groq_openrou: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Groq, OpenRouter — byose biri inyuma y'urubuga rumwe rwa chat rufite streaming ikora ako kanya binyuze muri Server-Sent Events. Agent isoma ibyiyumvo by'abakoresha ikabyitwaramo ifite amarangamutima + animation. Gahamagara imikorere, gukoresha ibikoresho bya MCP, artifacts. 100% open source.
launch_week.april_29_2026_nichxbt_posted_three_ws: Mata 29, 2026. @nichxbt yashyizeho three.ws — urubuga rufunguye rw'abakozi ba AI ba 3D bavuga, bibuka, bafite amavaleti, kandi bakora minting kuri blockchain. ibyo abantu 135,000 barebye mu masaha 24 ya mbere. Uwo munsi nyine: npm package yashyizweho, yashyizwe kuri MCP Registry ya Anthropic, yashyizwe kuri x402scan nka endpoint yishyurwa, ubushobozi bwa Pump.fun bwo gucuruza bw'umwimerere bwashyizweho, Solana vanity address generator yashyizweho, demo y'umukozi wa voice + X Spaces.
launch_week.asymmetric_posture_is_a_signal_following: Kutangana mu myifatire ni ikimenyetso. Dukurikira 11. Dukurikirwa na 3,675. Imibare iravuga ko: turi abashyira ahagaragara ibintu, ntabwo turi uruganda rwo gukurikira abandi. Abadukurikira bemejwe (359, ~10%) bakunze kuba abakoresha bafite ubushobozi buhanitse — ni bo tsinda nyine ryishyura, rikoresha mu kubaka, kandi rigatambutsa ibyo tuzashyira ahagaragara ubutaha.
launch_week.beyond_the_analytics_dashboard_three_ws_: Uretse dashboard y'isesengura, three.ws yashyizwe ku mazu y'ububiko, amashyinguranyandiko, n'amapulatifomu by'ingenzi cyane ku bikoresho by'abashinzwe iterambere bifunguye.
launch_week.build_your_ai_character_in_seconds: Baka umukozi wawe wa AI mu masogonda make
launch_week.cloud_infra_googlecloud_web3_startups_pr: Cloud + ibikorwa remezo: @GoogleCloud (gahunda ya Web3 Startups), @alibaba_cloud (yashyizwe kuri Marketplace). Amavunjiriro: @Coinbase + @CoinbaseWallet, @Bybit_Official, @JupiterExchange, @CoinGecko, @CoinMarketCap, Investing.com.
launch_week.copy_pasteable_version_below_every_metri: Iri hepfo hari verisiyo ushobora gukoporora no gufatanya — buri kipimo cyose cyagaragajwe neza, yagenewe gushyirwa ahagaragara ako kanya.
launch_week.cross_pollinated_authors_compound_the_we: Abanditsi bafatanyije barushaho kongera agaciro. Ibyanditswe byagize ababibona benshi mu cyumweru (ibihumbi 135) byaturutse kuri @nichxbt, ntabwo byaturutse kuri @trythreews. RT yo ku ya 7 Gicurasi yaturutse kuri @zhusu (ibihumbi 50 by'ababibonye) yabonetse kubera akazi, ntabwo ari kubera izina ry'ikigo. Koresha byombi — ijwi ry'uwashinze ikigo mu kuvuga inkuru, n'izina ry'ikigo mu matangazo y'ibikorwa by'umuryango.
launch_week.day_by_day_every_milestone_that_landed: Umunsi ku munsi: buri ntambwe yose yagezweho
launch_week.drag_and_drop_glb_viewer_with_pbr: Umurebaho wa GLB ushobora gukururwa no kurekura, ufite PBR rendering, IBL environments, postprocessing (bloom, tone mapping, FXAA). three.ws Studio yo guhindura avatar n'amashusho yimuka. Demo ikorana n'uyikoresha y'amashusho yimuka 32. Kudakora mu buryo bwa procedural, lip-sync, amarangamutima ashingiye ku byiyumvo. Kwinjiza mu murongo umwe biciye kuri <agent-3d> web component.
launch_week.each_name_below_was_earned_in_the: Buri zina riri hepfo ryabonetse mu cyumweru kimwe. Buri link yose ni urutonde rusanzwe cyangwa itangazo.
launch_week.elevenlabs_edge_tts_for_agent_voice_demo: ElevenLabs + Edge TTS ku ijwi rya agent. Icyerekano cya agent yinjira yonyine mu kiganiro cya X cy'ako kanya, isaba uburenganzira bwo kuvuga, ikumva, ikanasubiza. Kwiyandikisha ku bintu bya WebSocket — kwishyurwa → animation yo kwishimira; kugura bigatangira → agent igahita yitwara; kubikuza → byandikwa kuri timeline y'indangamuntu.
launch_week.elevenlabs_voice_cloning_from_3_10_secon: Gukora kopi y'ijwi rya ElevenLabs mu magambo y'amasegonda 3-10, gukuramo imyitwarire mu kiganiro gito cyo kwinjiza, no gutera imbuto z'ibyo yibuka byemewe biva kuri konti zihujwe — avatar ntabwo ari wowe gusa, ahubwo agent yitwara nka wowe.
launch_week.erc_8004_agent_registration_on_evm_solan: Kwiyandikisha kwa agent ya ERC-8004 kuri EVM. Ibyemezo bya Solana ku bwoko butandatu bw'ibikorwa: ibitekerezo, kwemeza, gutanga imirimo, kwemera imirimo, gukuraho, impaka. Delegation za ERC-7710 zifite imipaka — gutanga/gukuraho uburenganzira bufite igihe ntarengwa n'umubare ntarengwa. Gusuzuma byuzuye izina buri minota 5 binyuze muri cron.

launch_week.standards_ai_anthropicai_mcp_registry_pu: Ibihamya + AI: @AnthropicAI MCP Rejisitiri, @PulseMCP, ubunyamuryango bwa W3C (gutanga igitekerezo cy'itsinda rishya ry'abaturage ryitwa "3D AI Agents & Identity"), @Solana Frontier Hackathon binyuze muri @colosseum.
launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: Icyiciro cyihariye cya <agent-3d> kipakira buhoro buhoro iyo gihuye, gishyigikira ubwoko butanu bwa widget (turntable, gallery y'amashusho, agent uvuga, ERC-8004 passport card, hotspot tour), kandi kinyura Open Graph na oEmbed metadata ku buryo links zifunguka zifite uburyo bwiza bwo kugaragara. Widget Studio ikoreshwa mu gukanda gusa itanga code yo gukopera no gushyiramo. three.ws Studio ni editor yuzuye ya 3D avatar ikorera muri browser — pakira GLB, hindura skeleton + ibikoresho, wohereze. Sisitemu ya Marketplace + Skills Marketplace + Agent Reputation ituma agents zishobora kuboneka, kwinjiza amafaranga, no gushyirirwaho amanota. Bundles za CDN zifite verisiyo zoherezwa kuri /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
launch_week.the_flywheel_is_real_apr_29_founder: Umuvuduko urahari. Kwamamaza kw'abashinze ku ya 29 Mata (ibitekerezo 135K) → npm publish + MCP Rejisitiri + x402scan listing ku munsi umwe → Itangazo rya Google Cloud ku ya 30 Mata → Ubumenyi bwa Pump.fun + SDK yakozwe mu buryo bwa reverse engineering mu gihe kimwe → Alibaba + CoinGecko ku ya 2 Gicurasi → Solana Hackathon ku ya 4 Gicurasi (ibitekerezo 42K, 621 RTs) → Coinbase + Jupiter + Investing.com byose byegeranyijwe ku ya 5 Gicurasi (umunsi w'impinduka ukomeye wa 46K). Iposita imwe itanga indi.
launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: Itangazo rya Google Cloud ni ryo ryari iposita yagize uruhare runini mu cyumweru (~6.9K impinduka, 263 likes, 24 reposts) kandi ni yo shingiro rya cloud rizafasha icyiciro gikurikira cya platform.
launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: Episode ya podcast "Inside The 3D Agent Web" yasohotse kuri Amazon Music n'inyandiko yayo "Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body" yasohotse binyuze muri ecosystem ya Spotify-on-chain. Uburyo bubiri bwo gukwirakwiza, icyumweru kimwe gisigaye.
launch_week.the_may_5_peak_46k_impressions_and: Umunsi ukomeye wa 5 Gicurasi — impinduka 46K n'abakurikira bashya bagera ku 1,200 mu masaha 24 — byatewe n'uko Solana Frontier Hackathon listing yagezeho, itangazo rya Coinbase listing, na Jupiter Exchange verification byose byasohotse mu gihe kimwe.
launch_week.the_next_web_has_agents_in_it: Ikoranabuhanga rikurikira rifite agents. Bakeneye indangamuntu, umubiri, n'uburyo bwo gukora ibikorwa. Turimo kubaka ibipimo — n'ibicuruzwa, SDK, isoko, n'ubukungu bwa on-chain bubyunganira.
launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: Iyi puratifomu yashyizwe ku rutonde rw'abafatanyabikorwa kuri Alibaba Cloud, umuyoboro wacu wa mbere wo kugurishirizaho ku isoko rya 'cloud'. Tweet y'iyatangizwa yabonye ~7.1K views yonyine.
launch_week.the_post_reached_135_000_views_in: Iyi nyandiko yageze ku 135,000 views mu masaha atageze kuri 24. Mu cyumweru kimwe, @trythreews yavuye ku kuba izina rishya igera ku kuba konti yemewe ifite abayikurikira 3,675, endpoints eshatu zikora x402 zishyurwa, SDKs ebyiri zasohowe kuri npm, ubufatanye na Google Cloud na Alibaba Cloud, yashyizwe ku rutonde kuri Coinbase, Bybit, Jupiter, CoinGecko, na CoinMarketCap, ndetse no kwinjira muri Solana Frontier Hackathon.
launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: Ikarita y'inzira ikuraho icyuho hagati yo "gukoresha umuhanzi wa 3D" no "kwifotora (selfie)". Ibyiciro bine, byasobanuwe byimazeyo muri README rusange.
launch_week.the_thesis_build_a_real_product_ship: Igitekerezo nyamukuru: Kora igicuruzwa nyacyo, sohora ikintu buri munsi, vuga abafatanyabikorwa uko ubabonye. Ibindi byose bizikora.
launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: Umuryango wa three.ws X ni abantu bakusanyijwe — abashinzwe iterambere (developers), abubatsi bashishikajwe na agents, n'itsinda ry'abantu bakurikira ibintu mu buryo bwa live. Niho abazaba ba nyiri agents bazaturuka.
launch_week.three_listed_on_coinbase_coinbase_wallet: $THREE yashyizwe ku rutonde kuri Coinbase + Coinbase Wallet
launch_week.three_live_paid_endpoints_solana_token_t: Endpoints eshatu zikora zishyurwa: /api/x402/mint-to-mesh (token ya Solana → avatar ya 3D ifite insanganyamatsiko, $0.01 USDC), /api/x402/model-check (validator glTF yishyurwa), /api/insights/revenue-vision (ingamba za agent zikoresha Claude, $0.001 USDC). Zishobora kwivumbura ubwazo kuri /.well-known/x402.json. Umufasha wa CDP ukoresha ES256 JWT auth. Amayungurura menshi: Base (eip155:8453), Arbitrum (eip155:42161), Solana.
launch_week.three_live_x402_paid_endpoints_mint_to: Endpoints eshatu zikora x402 zishyurwa — mint-to-mesh, model-check, revenue-vision — zishobora kwivumbura ubwazo kuri /.well-known/x402.json. SDKs ebyiri zasohowe kuri npm: @three-ws/sdk na @three-ws/agent-payments v3.1. Indangamuntu ya ERC-8004 kuri chain. Delegations zifite urugero za ERC-7710. Ibyemezo bya Solana ku bwoko butandatu bw'ibikorwa.
launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Selfies eshatu (ibumoso, hagati, iburyo), kwongera kubaka isura mu buryo bwinshi bufashijwe na GPU, n'avatar yateguwe, ishobora gukoreshwa, yashyizweho nka token ya ERC-8004 mu minota itageze kuri mirongo itandatu. Uburyo bwo gufata amashusho bwibanze kuri mobile, bufite ubugenzuzi bw'ubuziranenge mu gihe nyacyo.
launch_week.three_ws: three.ws
launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws yateguwe mu bice bine bihanahana amakuru, hamwe na backend na package y'amasezerano. Buri gice kirakora kuri three.ws kandi kizasohoka nk'igice cya repo ifunguye. Dore urutonde.
launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: three.ws yashyizweho nka io.github.nirholas/three.ws kuri registry.modelcontextprotocol.io kandi irashobora kuboneka binyuze muri PulseMCP's curated directory. Umuhuzabikorwa uwo ari wo wose uzi MCP (harimo na Claude Desktop) ushobora guhuza no kuyobora avatars binyuze kuri JSON-RPC.
launch_week.tts_x_spaces_websocket_events: TTS · X Spaces · Ibirori bya WebSocket
launch_week.we_built_the_platform_that_gives_it: Twubatse urubuga ruyitanga. Mu cyumweru kimwe: urwego rwuzuye rwa 3D AI agent — umurebanyi, uburyo bwo gukora, indangamuntu kuri blockchain, ubwishyu, kwinjiza, n'isoko — hamwe na npm SDKs ebyiri, x402 endpoints eshatu zikora, ubufatanye na Google Cloud na Alibaba Cloud, kugaragara kuri Coinbase, Bybit, Jupiter, na CoinGecko, umwanya muri W3C, n'umuryango w'abubatsi 1,010. Iyi ni inyemezabuguzi.
launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Gukora ishusho ya WebGL 2.0 ifite inkunga yuzuye ya glTF 2.0 / GLB: gukanda geometry ya Draco, gukanda texture ya KTX2, kongera ubushobozi bwa Meshopt, amakarita y'ibidukikije ya HDR, ibikoresho bya PBR, animation y'uruhu, morph targets, na kamera zishyizwemo. Kwemeza bikorwa ku rwego rwa buri murongo binyuze muri Khronos gltf-validator. Lip-sync analyser ituma iminwa ihinduka bitewe n'ijwi rya agent mu gihe nyacyo. Gufata selfie + AvatarTurn integration bitanga avatars zishobora gukinishwa zivuye kuri kamera ya telefone. Gupakira ukurura ukarekura, OrbitControls ifite auto-rotation ishobora guhindurwa, na dat.GUI y'igihe nyacyo yo guhindura ako kanya.
launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Umurebanyi wa WebGL, LLM agent runtime, amasezerano y'indangamuntu ya ERC-8004, seriveri ya OAuth 2.1, MCP endpoint, n'igice cya web <agent-3d> — byose wasomye hejuru. Bikora kuri three.ws uyu munsi.
launch_week.weekend_doesn_t_sleep_the_biggest_single: Weekend ntabwo isinzira. Umunsi umwe munini (Gicurasi 5) wari ku Cyumweru. Ibyanditswe binini (Solana Hackathon, ibyarebwe 42K, 621 RTs) byasohotse ku wa Gatandatu. Crypto X iba maso igihe amakipe menshi y'ubucuruzi asinziriye. Kohereza ku mpera z'icyumweru.
