news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.an_open_source_mcp_server_for_watsonx: Seriveri ya MCP ifunguye (open-source) ya watsonx.ai. @three-ws/ibm-watsonx-mcp yerekana watsonx.ai — IBM Granite n'icyitegererezo icyo aricyo cyose kiri muri konti yawe — kuri buri mukiriya wa MCP (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor) nk'ibikoresho bitanu: kuganira, kurema inyandiko, embeddings, tokenization, no kuvumbura icyitegererezo.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.behind_the_3d_body_is_a_brain: Inyuma y'umubiri wa 3D hari ubwonko — kandi ubwo bwonko bushobora gukora kuri IBM watsonx.ai. Uku guhuza ni ukuri, kurakoreshwa, kandi ni open source, nta nzira y'ikigereranyo. Ibice bibiri bihuza three.ws na watsonx:
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.both_layers_run_on_your_own_ibm: Ibice byombi bikoresha amakuru y'umwirondoro wawe bwite wa IBM Cloud — urufunguzo rwa API ruhinduranywa n'ikimenyetso cya IAM cy'igihe gito kandi buri guhamagara kwa inference kugenewe umushinga wawe wa watsonx.ai, nta three.ws uhuza hagati ya agent yawe na IBM. Agent ya 3D yashyizwe ku rupapuro urwo arirwo rwose ishobora gutekereza kuri IBM Granite, ikorera imbere mu mushinga wawe wa watsonx.ai, iyobowe na konti yawe ya IBM Cloud.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.embedding_a_persistent_on_chain_3d_agent: Gushyira agent ya 3D ihoraho, iri kuri blockchain, muri platform iyo ari yo yose bigomba kuba byoroshye nko gushyira videwo ya YouTube. Tag imwe ya <agent-3d> itanga agent yuzuye — nta kwishyiraho (install), nta plugin, nta app y'umwimerere — igaragara muri browser iyo ari yo yose igezweho binyuze kuri WebGL. Igaragara ku rupapuro ni umuntu ufite isura, ijwi, ubwenge, amarangamutima, n'indangamuntu iri kuri blockchain ihoraho kuri za platform zitandukanye. Intego yo gutanga byoroshye: kwinjiza abantu miliyoni zikurikiyeho muri AI ifite umubiri, utabasabye kugira icyo bakuramo.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.meta_description: three.ws na IBM ni abafatanyabikorwa, kandi twerekanye demo mu buryo bwa live ku mugaragaro: agent ya 3D ihoraho, iri kuri blockchain, yashyizwe ku rupapuro urwo arirwo rwose byoroshye nka videwo ya YouTube — itekereza kuri IBM watsonx.ai na Granite. Demo za /ibm ziri ku mugaragaro ni ibikoresho byigenga by'abashinzwe guteza imbere, ntabwo ari ibyavuye mu bufatanye bwemewe. news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_an_open_source_stack: three.ws ni umurundo w'ikoranabuhanga rifunguye ku bakozi ba AI ba 3D bigenga bakora mu buryo bw'umwimerere muri mushinga-mbere. Buri tagi ya <agent-3d> ishyira hanze umukozi ufite indangamuntu ya NFT ya Solana (Metaplex Core), ububiko bwa ERC-8004 kuri EVM, umubiri wa 3D w'umwimerere wa mushinga-mbere muri WebGL biciye kuri three.js, ubwonko bwa LLM bukomoka kuri Claude, n'ubwishyu bw'umwimerere bwa x402 / HTTP 402 muri USDC kuri Base, BSC, na Solana.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_apache_2_0_from: three.ws ni Apache 2.0 kuva hejuru kugeza hasi — ureba, ikora, amasezerano y'indangamuntu, n'inyuma. Abakiriya ba AWS bashobora gusuzuma umurundo wose, kuwugabanyamo, no gukoresha iyabo bwite niba bashaka igenzura ryuzuye. Iyi soko kandi yamaze gutangira gukora kuri Alibaba Cloud Marketplace kandi yashyizwe muri BNB Chain Dappbay, Rejisitiri ya Model Context Protocol, na x402scan — AWS yiyunze ku ngamba zateguwe zo gukwirakwiza mu bicuruzwa byinshi by'ibicu.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_now_an_aws_partner: three.ws ubu ni Umufatanyabikorwa wa AWS. Iyi soko yanditswe mu nzira y'Ikoranabuhanga ya AWS Partner Network (APN) nk'Umufatanyabikorwa mu Ikoranabuhanga — izina ryemewe ku bagurisha software bigenga bakora ibicuruzwa ku bakiriya ba AWS.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_the_first_fully_on: three.ws ni isoko ya mbere yuzuye y'abakozi ba AI ba 3D bakora kuri blockchain muri AWS Partner Network. Buri tagi ya <agent-3d> iyi soko ikora ni umukinnyi wigenga Solana-wakozwe, ERC-8004-ufite ububiko, x402-wishyurwa — kandi uwo murundo ubu ni igice cy'uruganda rw'abafatanyabikorwa ba AWS.

nvidia_index.meta_twitter_description: Text-to-3D y'ubuntu ku bimodel byakiriwe na NVIDIA, hamwe n'umurongo wacu wa GPU twakiriye kuri L4 na Blackwell. Urufunguzo rumwe, nta konti, nta kiguzi.
nvidia_index.model_by_model_with_the_file_each: Model kuri model, hamwe n'idosiye buri imwe ikoresha:
nvidia_index.no_key_no_account_no_wallet_one: Nta rufunguzo, nta konti, nta wallet. POST imwe igarura GLB nyayo ushobora gufungura muri buri 3D viewer. Iyi ni yo endpoint imwe UI ya browser ikoresha.
nvidia_index.nvidia_hosted_models_one_key: Bimodel byakiriwe na NVIDIA, urufunguzo rumwe
nvidia_index.one_wire_contract_across_every_worker_so: Amasezerano y'umurongo umwe kuri buri mukoresha, ku buryo umurongo uwo ari wo wose ushobora kwimukira ku wundi
nvidia_index.photo_checks_before_reconstruction_alt_t: Kugenzura amafoto mbere yo kongera kubaka, inyandiko isimbura
nvidia_index.physically_based_materials_basecolor_met: Ibikoresho bishingiye ku mubiri: baseColor, metallicRoughness, na normal maps
nvidia_index.published_on_the_nvidia_developer_forums: Byasohotse ku mbuga za NVIDIA Developer Forums: impamvu model ya vision ya 12B iri imbere ya 3D generator yari ingenzi kurusha 3D generator ubwayo.
nvidia_index.run_the_same_text_to_3d_model: Koresha model imwe ya text-to-3D kuri NVIDIA GPU yawe bwite ukoresheje NIM, hanyuma uyereke umukiriya maze wongere kubaka ukoresheje amafoto.
nvidia_index.self_host_trellis_on_your_own_nim: Wakire TRELLIS wowe ubwawe kuri NIM yawe bwite
nvidia_index.sharpening_retrieval_before_an_answer: Gutyaza uburyo bwo kubona amakuru mbere y'igisubizo
nvidia_index.text_to_3d_that_costs_a_visitor: Inyandiko kuri 3D idatwara umushyitsi ikiguzi kandi idasaba konti
nvidia_index.the_brain_workbench_model_picker: Itoranya rya model rya Brain workbench
nvidia_index.the_field_report_a_memory_backed_that: Raporo y'akazi: /tmp ishyigikiwe na memori ihagarika instance ya 32 GiB hagati yo gupakira, cu124 wheels nta sm_120 kernels, n'ingano y'akarere yahinduye amahitamo yacu ya GPU.
nvidia_index.the_keyless_generate_lane_on_forge: Umurongo wo kubyara udafite urufunguzo kuri /forge
nvidia_index.twelve_cloud_run_gpu_services_each_a: Serivisi cumi n'ebyiri za Cloud Run GPU, buri imwe ikaba umukoresha upfunyika model imwe, zikiyongera bitewe n'umurongo. Cumi n'imwe kuri nvidia-l4, imwe kuri nvidia-rtx-pro-6000 (Blackwell). Aha ni ho imirongo ya realism yishyurwa iba, kandi ni ho ibikoresho bya PBR, rigging, n'imigendo bikorerwa.
nvidia_index.two_tutorials_you_can_follow_end_to: Inyigisho ebyiri ushobora gukurikira kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo, n'inyandiko ebyiri z'ubujijuke ku buryo stack yubatswe.
nvidia_index.type_a_sentence_get_a_textured_3d: Andika interuro, ubone model ya 3D ifite texture. Iyo nzira ikora kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo kuri NVIDIA silicon, kandi kuri three.ws umurongo wa mbere wayo ni ubuntu, udafite urufunguzo, kandi ni open source. Iyi page ni ikarita y'ukuri y'uburyo: bimodel byakiriwe na NVIDIA bikora iki, GPU zacu bwite dukoresha, n'ibyo twize tubishyira mu bikorwa.
nvidia_index.what_we_run_ourselves_and_on_which: Ibyo dukoresha ubwacu, n'ikarita dukoresha. Buri murongo ni serivisi ya Cloud Run yihariye ifite politiki yayo yo kwiyongera, bityo akazi k'uburyo bw'amashusho kagenda gahoro ntikajye mu murongo inyuma y'akazi ko gushyiraho imiterere.

objects.a_curated_library_of_cc0_3d_objects: Ububiko bwatoranyijwe neza bw'ibintu bya 3D bya CC0 n'ibikoresho — ibikoresho byo mu nzu, amatara, ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga, ibikoresho byo kubikamo, imitako. Buri kimwe ni icya rubanda: kubikoresha mu bucuruzi nta kiguzi, nta kimenyetso cy'uwabikoze gisabwa. Reba ikintu icyo aricyo cyose ako kanya mu mushakisha wawe, cyangwa ukuremo GLB ukabikoresha aho ariho hose.
objects.free_3d_props_ready_to_drop_into: Ibikoresho bya 3D by'ubuntu, biteguye gushyirwa muri buri gice cyose.
objects.meta_description: Amagana y'ibintu bya 3D bya CC0 by'ubuntu n'ibikoresho — ibikoresho byo mu nzu, amatara, ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga, ibikoresho byo kubikamo, imitako. Reba icyo aricyo cyose ako kanya, cyangwa ukuremo GLB ukabikoresha aho ariho hose. Nta kimenyetso cy'uwabikoze gisabwa.
objects.meta_og_description: Ibikoresho bya 3D bya CC0 by'ubuntu, biteguye gushyirwa muri buri gice cyose. Reba mbere, kora animation, cyangwa ubikoreshe muri Studio.
objects.meta_twitter_description: Ibikoresho bya 3D bya CC0 by'ubuntu, biteguye gushyirwa muri buri gice cyose.
objects.something_went_wrong_loading_the_object_: Hari ikibazo cyabaye mu gushyiraho ububiko bw'ibintu.
objects.the_cc0_object_library_is_being_staged: Ububiko bw'ibintu bya CC0 buri gutegurwa. Ongera ugenzure nyuma y'akanya gato, cyangwa urema icyawe ukoresheje amagambo.

openai_index.add_a_humanoid_skeleton_to_an_existing: Ongeraho igikanka cy'umuntu kuri GLB isanzwe ihari kugira ngo ishobore gukorwaho animation.
openai_index.add_it_as_a_connector_with_no: Kiyongeraho nk'umuhuza nta kwemeza umwirondoro. Gisubiza buri cyifuzo ako kanya binyuze kuri POST.
openai_index.an_mcp_connector_for_chatgpt_with_ten: Umuyoboro wa MCP wa ChatGPT ufite ibikoresho icumi by'ubuntu. Ibisubizo bigaragara muri widget y'uburyo bwo kureba model-viewer mu buryo bw'imikoranire mu kiganiro, hamwe na CSP ya widget yatangajwe kugira ngo amamodeli yinjire muri ChatGPT nyayo.
openai_index.an_open_cc0_response_shape_for_returning: Uburyo bwo gusubiza bwa CC0 bufunguye bwo kugarura ishusho ya 3D iriho nk'igisubizo cy'igikoresho cy'ibanze: ishusho GLB, kamera, ibidukikije, animation, ihererekanyabubasha rya AR. Umukiriya uwo ari we wese ashobora kuyigaragaza, atari uwacu gusa.
openai_index.art_directed_mesh_generation_from_text_o: Gukora imiterere ya 3D (mesh) iyobowe n'ubugeni, uhereye ku nyandiko cyangwa ifoto.
openai_index.assistants_are_excellent_at_text_and_ima: Abafasha bazi cyane gukora ku nyandiko n'amashusho, ariko ntibigeze bagira icyo bavuga mu buryo bwa 3D. Igishushanyo mbonera ushobora kuzenguruka, kugishyira mu buryo bwo kugikoresha (rig), kugihindura (animate), no kugishyira mu cyumba cyawe cyo kuriramo, ni igisubizo gitandukanye n'ifoto yacyo gusa. three.ws ibaho kugira ngo ubwo buryo bwo gusubiza buhinduke ibisanzwe: uburyo bwa protocole ifunguye, umuyoboro w'ubuntu, n'ikoranabuhanga rifunguye (open-source stack) munsi yabyose. Kwitwa umufatanyabikorwa watoranyijwe wa OpenAI ni ubuhamya bwo gukomeza kubaka byinshi.
openai_index.collect_a_generation_that_outran_its_too: Kusanya igisekuru cyarenze guhamagara igikoresho cyacyo. Gusoma gusa, kandi ntikigera ikoresha igipimo cyo kubyara.
openai_index.every_generated_model_carries_a_one_tap: Buri gishushanyo mbonera cyakozwe kigira umurongo wa AR ukanda rimwe. iOS ibona Quick Look USDZ ihinduwe ako kanya, Android ikabona Scene Viewer intent, naho mudasobwa ikabona umurebereshi wa WebGL.
openai_index.four_live_surfaces_all_free_and_keyless: Ubuso bune bukora, bwose bw'ubuntu kandi budasaba urufunguzo. Bwose ni open source.
openai_index.generate_a_3d_avatar_from_a_prompt: Kora avatar ya 3D uhereye ku butumwa cyangwa ifoto y'icyitegererezo.
openai_index.generate_a_textured_3d_model_from_a: Kora igishushanyo mbonera cya 3D gifite imiterere (textured) uhereye ku butumwa bwanditse. Gisubiza GLB.
openai_index.iterate_by_describing_a_change_make_it: Subiramo usobanura impinduka ("gihindure icyuma"), gifite amateka y'impinduka ashobora gusubizwa inyuma.
openai_index.make_the_body_speak_a_line_lip: Umubiri uvuge ijambo: guhuza iminwa n'ijwi, imyerekano, n'ibimenyetso byose hamwe.
openai_index.meta_description: three.ws ni umufatanyabikorwa watoranyijwe wa OpenAI mu rwego rwa OpenAI Partner Network. Huza seriveri y'ubuntu ya three.ws 3D Studio MCP na ChatGPT maze uhindure ubutumwa (prompt) igishushanyo mbonera cya 3D gikora, gishobora gukoreshwa (riggable), kandi cyiteguye AR, mu kiganiro.
openai_index.meta_og_description: Gukora 3D ku buntu muri ChatGPT: huza seriveri ya three.ws 3D Studio MCP maze ubone igishushanyo mbonera gikora mu kiganiro, gishobora gukoreshwa (riggable), gishobora guhindurwa (animatable), kandi gishobora gushyirwa muri AR.

openai_index.none_no_key_no_account_no_wallet: Nta na kimwe. Nta rufunguzo, nta konti, nta mukwabu.
openai_index.one_call_generate_the_mesh_and_rig: Guhamagara rimwe: kora imiterere ya 3D (mesh) uyishyire mu buryo bwo gukoreshwa (rig), inyuma y'urugi rwa humanoid.
openai_index.reload_a_persona_in_a_fresh_session: Ongera ushyireho persona mu isesheni nshya. Indangamuntu ni ubushobozi.
openai_index.six_generation_tools_a_collector_plus_th: Ibikoresho bitandatu byo kubyara, umusaruzi ufata ikidashushanyo cyatwaye igihe kirenze icyiciro kimwe, hamwe n'ibikoresho bitatu bya persona biha umufasha umubiri ubaho, uvuga mu buryo bwa lip-syncing mu gice. Byose icumi by'ubuntu, byose byatewe inkunga n'umukoresha.
openai_index.the_same_free_lane_as_a_rest: Uburyo bw'ubuntu bumwe n'ubuso bwa REST Actions bwa GPT yihariye ya "three.ws 3D Studio", bufite urugi rw'umutekano rw'imyaka 13+ n'ibisubizo bisukuye. Bikubiyemo gahunda zidafite ubufasha bw'umuyoboro.
openai_index.three_ws_has_been_named_an_openai: three.ws yagizwe Umufatanyabikorwa watoranyijwe wa OpenAI mu rwego rwa OpenAI Partner Network. Umuyoboro w'ubuntu wa 3D Studio wa platform uhindura interuro igishushanyo mbonera cya 3D gikora, gifite imiterere (textured), kigaragara mu kiganiro, hanyuma kikagishyira mu buryo bwo gukoreshwa (rigs), kikagihindura (animates), kandi kikagishyira mu cyumba cyawe muri AR. Nta rufunguzo, nta konti, nta kiguzi.
openai_index.three_ws_is_an_independent_member_of: three.ws ni umunyamuryango wigenga wa OpenAI Partner Network ku rwego rwa Select. Iyi paji isobanura ibicuruzwa bya three.ws byuzuzanya na platform za OpenAI; ntabwo ari igicuruzwa cya OpenAI kandi ntabwo ishyigikiwe na OpenAI uretse izina ry'umufatanyabikorwa ryerekanwe. OpenAI, ChatGPT, na ikirango cya OpenAI Partner Network ni ibirango bya OpenAI. Menya byinshi kuri uru ruyange kuri openai.com/business/partners.
openai_index.turn_a_generated_avatar_into_a_persisten: Hindura avatar yakozwe ikore umubiri uhoraho, ufite izina, ushobora kongera gukorwa ukoresheje id.
openai_index.what_we_ship_on_openai_surfaces: Ibyo dukora kuri platform za OpenAI.

oracle.best_ath_multiple_among_coin_title: ATH nyinshi cyane mu mafaranga Oracle yagaragaje (Urwego rwa Lean cyangwa hejuru) — kanda urebe ibimenyetso
oracle.best_ath_view_proof: ATH nziza cyane× →—reba ibimenyetso
oracle.call_win_rate: Igipimo cyo gutsinda kw'ibyo yavuze →—
oracle.coins_at_strong_tier_right_n_title: Amafaranga ari ku rwego rwa Strong ubu — kanda uyungurure ibyinjira
oracle.coins_oracle_actually_called_title: Amafaranga Oracle yagaragaje — Urwego rwa Lean cyangwa hejuru
oracle.coins_sitting_at_prime_tier_title: Amafaranga ari ku rwego rwa Prime ubu — kanda uyungurure ibyinjira
oracle.coins_the_oracle_called_at_conviction_an: Amafaranga Oracle yagaragaje ifite icyizere — n'uko byarangiye. Buri karita yerekana amanota yo kwinjira ugereranyije n'umusaruro nyakuri: yarangije, ATH nyinshi, cyangwa byombi. Ibimenyetso, ntabwo ari amasezerano.
oracle.coins_whose_oracle_conviction_score_move: Amafaranga amanota y'icyizere ya Oracle yahindutse cyane mu masaha 24 ashize — imiterere yihuta cyane n'ihungabana rikomeye. Abazamuka ni imiterere ibona imbaraga mbere y'uko igera kuri Prime; abamanuka ni ibitekerezo birangira ako kanya.
oracle.distinct_agents_currently_ar_title: Abagenzi batandukanye bateguwe ubu ku cyizere cya Oracle — kanda urebe urutonde rw'abatsinze
oracle.every_move_your_agent_makes_simulated_or: Buri gikorwa umugenzi wawe akora — yaba yigana cyangwa ariho — kigera hano, hanyuma kigahabwa amanota ugereranyije n'umusaruro. Iki ni igitabo cy'ibipimo byo gutsinda by'umugenzi wawe.
oracle.every_oracle_armed_agent_action_in_real: Buri gikorwa cy'umugenzi wateguwe na Oracle mu gihe nyacyo — ibyo isoko ryigenga rigura, ibyatsinze, n'ibyatatsinze. Ibikorwa byigana n'ibiriho byose hamwe.
oracle.every_scored_coin_as_a_sphere_in: Buri faranga ryahawe amanota nk'umubumbe mu mwanya wa 3D. Ingano = amanota y'icyizere. Ibara = urwego. Kurura kugira ngo uzenguruke, zunguruka kugira ngo ukure. Kanda kuri buri mubumbe kugira ngo ufungure ibisobanuro byuzuye by'icyizere cyawo.
oracle.every_scored_coin_including_title: Buri faranga ryahawe amanota, harimo Kwitegereza/Kwihunza — uburyo bw'isoko, ntabwo ari ikimenyetso cy'ubushobozi
oracle.every_wallet_oracle_has_judged_ranked_by: Buri wallet Oracle yagenzuye, yashyizwe ku rutonde hashingiwe ku mateka yayo nyayo — uko ikunze kuba umuguzi wa mbere w'amafaranga yaje kurangiza, ugereranyije n'uko ikunze gutakaza cyangwa kureka abayikurikira. Uku ni ko gukomoka gutanga imbaraga ku manota y'icyizere.
oracle.meta_description: Oracle ihuriza hamwe abaguze, uko baguze, icyo ikiceri ari cyo, n'uko kigenda mu barura rimwe ry'ukuri ririho kuri buri itangizwa rya pump.fun — kandi bigatuma umukozi wawe wa AI wa 3D akora ku mikorere ifite icyizere kinini. Uko amakuru menshi tugenzura, niko ibarura ryose rirushaho kuba neza.
oracle.meta_og_description: Ibarura rimwe ry'ukuri kuri buri itangizwa rya pump.fun, ryahujwe n'amakuru yuzuye y'ibihamya bya wallet + ikiceri + imiterere. Urebe muri ako kanya. Ha umukozi wawe ubushobozi bwo kubikoraho.
oracle.meta_title: Oracle — imyanzuro y'ukuri yahujwe pump.fun · three.ws
oracle.meta_twitter_description: Ibarura rimwe ry'ukuri ririho kuri buri itangizwa, ryahujwe n'amakuru menshi kuri pump.fun. Ha umukozi wawe ubushobozi bwo kubikoraho.
oracle.oracle_agents_ranked_by_their_real_convi: Abakozi ba Oracle bashyizwe ku rwego hashingiwe ku mateka yabo y'imyanzuro y'ukuri — buri cyemezo cyose kigenzurwa n'ukuri nyako. Hagaragazwa gusa abakozi bafite ibyavuyemo byamenyekanye. Iyandikishe kugira ngo ukore nk'abakora neza kurusha abandi.
oracle.oracle_fuses_four_reads_on_every_pump: Oracle ihuriza hamwe amakuru ane kuri buri itangizwa rya pump.fun — uwagura (uburyo bwa wallet yizewe), uko igurwa (guhuriza hamwe vs. imiterere karemano), icyo ari cyo (inkomoko y'umuco), na uko igenda — mu barura rimwe ry'ukuri ryagaragara neza riri hagati ya 0 na 100. Uko ibiceri na wallets byinshi tugenzura, niko ibarura ryose rirushaho kuba neza. Hanyuma ha umukozi wawe wa 3D ubushobozi bwo gukora ku mikorere irenze urwego rwawe. Soma inyandiko ↗
oracle.prime_now_filter_feed: Iby'ibanze ubu →—yungurura ibyinjira
oracle.proof_not_promises_every_conviction_verd: Ibihamya, ntabwo ari amasezerano. Buri myanzuro y'ukuri yose igenzurwa n'ukuri nyako — ese ikiceri cyazamutse, cyaguye, cyangwa cyahagurutse? Dupima ijanisha ry'intsinzi nyayo ku rwego, tukagaragaza urwego rw'icyizere rwa 95% kuri buri mubare, kandi tugashushanya uburyo bwo kugereranya kugira ngo ubone ko ibarura rishira ibiceri ku rwego hashingiwe ku mahirwe. Inyungu ibarwa gusa niba imyanzuro y'ukuri irusha kugura utazi — kandi turabigaragaza n'iyo bitabaye bityo.
oracle.share_of_resolved_lean_stron_title: Igipimo cy'imihigo ya Lean/Strong/Prime yatsinze (yageze ku ntego, cyangwa yikubye inshuro ≥2 nta gutubya) — kanda hano urebe ibisobanuro byuzuye by'inyungu
oracle.show_only_coins_on_your_watc_title: Erekana ibiceri gusa biri ku rutonde rwawe rw'ibyo ukurikirana
oracle.strong_now_filter_feed: Ikomeye ubu →—yungurura amakuru
oracle.your_agent_watches_the_live_conviction_s: Agent yawe ikurikirana amakuru y'icyizere mu gihe nyacyo ikanahita ikora ako kanya igiceri cyujuje ibyo usabwa — igura umwanya muto ikoresheje kode yayo bwite Solana. Shyiraho amategeko ku rupapuro rwuzuye rw'igenamiterere; dore uko yateguwe muri make ubu.

oracle_docs.24_endpoints_json_sse_serving_the_feed: ~24 endpoints (JSON + SSE) zitanga amakuru, ibisobanuro by'ifaranga, ubumenyi bw'ububiko bw'amafaranga, kwiga ibyahise, imigezi, n'ahagenewe imiterere y'umukozi. Bibikwa mu buryo bw'agateganyo kuri CDN; bifite umuvuduko ntarengwa kuri buri IP.
oracle_docs.3d_graph_every_scored_coin_as_a: Igishushanyo mbonera cya 3D. Buri faranga ryahawe amanota rishushanywa nk'umubumbe, rihurijwe hamwe bitewe n'inkuru, ingano yaryo ikagenwa n'icyizere. (Imibumbe igaragarira kuri hardware ya GPU; iyi foto yerekana igice cy'iboneza.)
oracle_docs.72h_retention: score, tier, pillars, scored_at · kugumana mu masaha 72
oracle_docs.a_coin_s_conviction_time_series_sparklin: Urukurikirane rw'igihe rw'icyizere cy'ifaranga (amakuru ya sparkline) rugaragaza umuvuduko wo kuzamuka/kugabanuka/guhagarara.
oracle_docs.a_coin_s_live_buy_sell_tape: Amakuru y'igihe nyacyo y'ifaranga y'ubugure/ubugurishwe, buri bucuruzi buherekejwe n'imiterere y'ububiko bw'amafaranga bw'umucuruzi.
oracle_docs.a_conviction_score_is_a_probabilistic_cl: Amanota y'icyizere ni ikirego gishingiye ku bushoboka, kandi ikirego gishingiye ku bushoboka nta gaciro gifite keretse gishyizwe mu ngiro. Oracle ihuza buri cyemezo n'ukuri kwacyo kandi ikagaragaza ibyavuyemo kuri page — harimo n'igihe itandukaniro ari rito. Iki ni cyo gitandukanya icyitegererezo n'amarangamutima.
oracle_docs.a_dynamic_1200_630_opengraph_conviction_: Ikarita y'icyizere ya OpenGraph ya 1200×630 ihindagurika (SVG) yo gusangiza abandi ifaranga.
oracle_docs.a_hard_ceiling_on_the_final_score: Igisenge ntarengwa ku manota ya nyuma, gishyirwaho n'ikimenyetso gitukura gikomeye cy'imiterere cyangwa ubwoko, gikoreshwa mbere yo gukomanywa.
oracle_docs.a_high_score_is_the_weight_of: Amanota menshi ni uburemere bw'ibimenyetso biri kuri blockchain, ntabwo ari garanti. pump.fun irwanya kandi ifite umurizo munini — ibyinshi mu bitangizwa biratsindwa, ndetse n'uburyo bwateguwe neza bukunze gutsindwa. Soma urwego nk'amahirwe, ushyireho ingano ikwiye, kandi ntukigere utega icyo udashobora gutakaza.
oracle_docs.a_long_lived_node_process_running_three: Uburyo bwa Node bumara igihe kirekire bukoresha imizenguruko itatu yigenga — score (kugumana imyanzuro ishobora gukoreshwa), agent (gukora ku masaha yateguwe), na settle (gutanga amanota ku bisubizo) — buri kimwe cyihagararira ubwacyo kugira ngo inzira yoroheje idahagarike iyihuta.
oracle_docs.a_model_you_can_only_trust_when: Icyitegererezo ushobora kwizera gusa iyo kigushimagije ntacyo kimaze. Dore ibyo Oracle idashobora gukora, aho ishobora kwibeshya, n'uburyo yakomejwe.
oracle_docs.a_pump_fun_coin_that_completed_its: Igiceri cya pump.fun cyarangije umurongo wacyo wo guhuza — ikimenyetso nyamukuru cy'intsinzi.
oracle_docs.a_pure_side_effect_free_scoring_function: Imikorere yo gutanga amanota idafite ingaruka z'inyongera, yuzuye (convict()) hamwe n'urwego rwo gukusanya amakuru rurinda. Uhawe mint, itanga amanota, urwego, isesengura ry'inkingi, n'impamvu. Nta I/O mu gihe cyo gutanga amanota — ishobora kugeragezwa byuzuye.
oracle_docs.a_scored_coin_is_a_win_if: Igiceri cyahawe amanota ni intsinzi niba cyararangije, cyangwa cyaragize inshuro ≥2× za ATH kitagize ikibazo cyo gukorera uburiganya; igihombo niba cyarakorewe uburiganya cyangwa cyaragumye munsi ya 1.2×; kirahagaze hagati. Ingingo "kitagize ikibazo cyo gukorera uburiganya" irakomeye: ibitangizwa byinshi bisanzwe byiyongera inshuro 2× kuva bigitangira mbere yo gusenyuka, kandi kubara izo ntera nk'intsinzi byatuma pump-and-dumps byongera umubare ugomba kubigaragaza. oracle_docs.the_pedigree_leaderboard_every_judged_wa: Urutonde rw'abayoboye mu mateka — buri wallet yagenzuwe yashyizwe ku rwego hashingiwe ku mateka yayo.
oracle_docs.the_pillars_are_venue_agnostic_who_how: Inkingi ntizigengwa n'aho zikorerwa — 'who/how/what/move' birakoreshwa ahantu hose hashobora gutangirizwa ibintu bifite ibimenyetso kuri blockchain. Ubwihare bw'ubwonko niho urunigi rushya rwinjirira.
oracle_docs.the_problem_asymmetric_information_at_th: Ikibazo: amakuru atangana ku muvuduko wa block.
oracle_docs.the_product_is_keyboard_driven_focuses_s: Iki gicuruzwa gikoreshwa na keyboard (<kbd>/</kbd> ituma ushakisha, imibare iri kuri keyboard igufasha kwimuka hagati ya tabs, imyambi igufasha kugenda hagati yazo), kiyoboka rwose, kandi cyubatswe ku mabara y'ikijuju yonyine aho urumuri rugaragaza imbaraga — urushijeho kumurika niho kwizera kuba gukomeye.
oracle_docs.the_proven_wins_gallery_ordered_by_ath: Ibyegeranyo by'intsinzi zagaragaye, bitondekanyijwe hakurikijwe ATH multiple, hamwe n'incamake.
oracle_docs.the_question_is_real_buying_pressure_act: Ikibazo: ese koko hariho igitutu nyacyo cyo kugura, ubu? Momentum isoma ikimenyetso cya mbere — uburinganire bwo kugura/kugurisha, umuvuduko abaguzi bashya binjiriramo, n'ingano y'ibyo umudevi yaguze nk'ikimenyetso.
oracle_docs.the_question_is_this_a_fair_launch: Ikibazo: ese uku gutangiza ni ukuri cyangwa ni ukwateguwe? Imiterere ni urwego rwo kwirinda. Isoma uburyo byatanzwe n'igihe byatangirijwe — amahirwe yo kubundika, kwegeranya abafite, igitutu cyo gusnipiga, guhinga amavaleti mashya, amatsinda y'abaterankunga umwe, kugurisha kwa dev — kandi igororera abantu benshi, b'umwimerere mu gihe ihana ubufatanye no kwegeranya.
oracle_docs.the_question_what_is_this_coin_about: Ikibazo: iyi coin ivuga iki, kandi inkuru yayo irashobora gukomeza mu muco? Inkuru ishyira gutangiza mu byiciro cumi na kimwe (meme, AI, umuco, amakuru, inyamaswa, icyamamare, politiki, umuryango, ikoranabuhanga, akamaro, kitazwi) kandi igena umuvuduko wayo wo gukwirakwira — by'umwihariko ikoresheje uburyo bw'ururimi buhabwa amakuru agezweho ya crypto kugira ngo ishobore kumenya coin iri kuvugwa mu makuru y'ubu.
oracle_docs.the_question_who_is_already_in_this: Ikibazo: ni ba nde basanzwe muri iyi coin, kandi amateka yabo ni ayahe? Pedigree ihemba gutangiza aho amavaleti afite amateka yagaragaye yo kwinjira mu batsinze kare asanzwe agura — kandi igahana abazwi nka ruggers, dumpers, n'abahanga mu gutangiza ibyapfubye kenshi.
oracle_docs.the_scoring_is_a_pure_function_of: Amanota ni imikorere y'amakuru yegeranyijwe. Buri kintu gifite imiterere — kwinjiza, kubika, gushyira mu bikorwa, kwishyura — kiba hanze yacyo. Uwo mupaka niwo utuma imibare ishobora kugeragezwa, imyanzuro ikongera gukorwa, kandi moteri imwe igakoresha live feed, API, n'icyemezo cya agent ifite ibisubizo bimwe.
oracle_docs.the_snapshot_above_is_a_thin_low: Agashusho kagaragajwe hejuru ni gake, kandi kadahagije — imibare y'intsinzi yagezweho iri munsi y'igice cyo hagati cy'urwego kandi ibiceri bike byageze ku rwego rwo hejuru. Ibyo biragaragara, ntibihishwe. Urupapuro rwubatswe kugira ngo rwerekane intege nke kimwe n'imbaraga, kuko ikizamini cy'inyuma wizeye gusa iyo kigushimishije atari ikizamini cy'inyuma.
oracle_docs.the_system_gets_sharper_the_more_it: Sisitemu irushaho kuba nyayo uko irushaho gukurikirana, binyuze ku biziga bibiri by'iterambere. Uruziga rw'iterambere rw'amakuru: buri kintu cyakemuwe kivugurura igishushanyo mbonera cy'icyubahiro cya wallet gitanga imbaraga inkingi ya WHO, bityo ibisobanuro bya "amafaranga y'ubwenge" birahora byongera kwibonerwa, ntibihabwa agaciro rimwe gusa. Uruziga rw'iterambere rwo kugereranya: buri kintu cyapimwe gituma ikizamini cy'inyuma kirushaho kuba gikomeye, bigaragaza neza aho amanota afite icyizere cyinshi cyangwa gike kugira ngo icyitegererezo gishobore kongera gupimwa hashingiwe ku kuri aho kuba ku bitekerezo.
oracle_docs.the_what_pillar_depends_on_a_language: Inkingi ya WHAT ishingiye ku cyitegererezo cy'ururimi n'amakuru; byombi bishobora gusoma nabi inkuru cyangwa kubura inkuru yihuse. Ni yo nkingi ifite agaciro gake kubera iyo mpamvu, kandi ihinduka icyiciro cy'ibanze gipima neza aho kugwa.
oracle_docs.the_what_pillar_is_the_only_place: Inkingi ya WHAT ni yo yonyine Oracle igera hanze y'ubwonko. Kugira ngo ishyire mu byiciro inkuru yo gutangiza, ikura inkuru z'ingenzi za crypto ziriho muri API y'amakuru rusange (ibitswe ~90s), ikazishyira mu butumwa bw'icyitegererezo cy'ururimi, ikasaba icyiciro, inkuru ngufi, igipimo cy'uko yakwirakwira, n'icyizere. Igiceri kiri mu nkuru z'ingenzi z'uyu munsi kiramenyekana nk'icyo kandi kigahabwa amanota menshi. Niba icyitegererezo kitabonetse, icyiciro cy'ibanze gipima neza amagambo y'ingenzi kirakoreshwa kugira ngo umwanzuro uhore utangwa.
oracle_docs.the_wins_gallery_resolved_calls_with_the: Urutonde rw'intsinzi — ibyemezo byakemuwe n'amanota yabyo yo kwinjira ugereranije n'ibyo byagezweho.
oracle_docs.the_worker_is_configured_entirely_by_env: Umukozi ategurwa rwose n'ibidukikije. Ibipimo byatoranyijwe (n'ibipimo bisanzwe): ORACLE_MODE=simulate, ORACLE_NETWORK=mainnet, ORACLE_SCORE_INTERVAL_MS=15000, ORACLE_AGENT_INTERVAL_MS=3000, ORACLE_SETTLE_INTERVAL_MS=60000, ORACLE_SCORE_BATCH=20, ORACLE_RESCORE_AFTER_SEC=180, ORACLE_MAX_TRADE_SOL=0.25 (igipimo ntarengwa cyo kugurisha), na ORACLE_GLOBAL_KILL=1 (ihagarika ibikorwa byose by'umukozi n'iby'ubwishingizi mu gihe amanota akomeje). Uburyo bwa Live busaba kandi ibanga rikoreshwa mu gusobanura wallets z'abakozi, kandi ntibushobora gutangira nta ryo.
oracle_docs.these_docs_are_written_in_two_layers: Aya mabwiriza yanditswe mu byiciro bibiri kugira ngo urupapuro rumwe rube rwiza ku muntu mushya ushaka kumenya n'umuhanga mu mibare ushaka uburyo bwuzuye.
oracle_docs.this_buy_would_exceed_the_24h_spend: ubu buguzi bwarenga igipimo ntarengwa cyo gukoresha mu masaha 24
oracle_docs.three_ways_in_depending_on_what_you: Uburyo butatu bwo kwinjira, bitewe n'ibyo ushaka kuri Oracle uyu munsi.
oracle_docs.transparency_over_magic_every_score_ship: Kugaragara neza kuruta amayobera. Buri nota ritangwa hamwe n'impamvu zaryo. Nta musaruro w'icyitegererezo udasobanutse usabwa kwizera — ushobora gusoma impamvu igiceri cyabonye amanota 82 cyangwa kikagera kuri 46.
oracle_docs.two_coins_can_both_score_70_for: Ibiceri bibiri bishobora kubona amanota 70 kubera impamvu zitandukanye rwose — kimwe kubera amateka meza ariko kidafite imbaraga nyinshi, ikindi kubera inkuru yakwirakwiriye cyane ariko ifite ishingiro ridakomeye. Icyiciro kikubwira imbaraga; impamvu zikubwira impamvu, kandi impamvu ni yo ushingiraho ugurisha.
oracle_docs.two_design_commitments_make_that_bet_hon: Ibyemezo bibiri by'igishushanyo bituma ubwo bucuruzi buba bwizewe:
oracle_docs.two_win_rates_are_published_deliberately: Hari ibipimo bibiri by'intsinzi bitangazwa, byatandukanyijwe ku bushake: igipimo cy'intsinzi y'ibyo byasabwe (ibiceri byemejwe na Oracle byahawe amanota ya Lean, Strong, cyangwa Prime — ibyiciro ikubwira gukoraho) n'igipimo fatizo cy'isoko (buri gikorwa cyatangijwe cyahawe amanota — icyo kugura byose utitayeho byatanga). Kugeza igihe ibyo byasabwe nyabyo byemejwe, igipimo cy'intsinzi y'ibyo byasabwe kigaragaza "nta byasabwe byemejwe na gato"; igipimo fatizo ntikigaragazwa na rimwe nk'ubuhanga bwa moteri.
oracle_docs.unlike_the_normal_approximation_the_wils: Bitandukanye n'igereranya risanzwe p ± z·√(p(1−p)/n), intera ya Wilson iguma muri [0,1], ntiyagabanuka ikagira ubugari bwa zeru kuri p=0 cyangwa p=1, kandi ikora neza ku n ntoya ibipimo bya mbere bishya bigira. Iyo ni itandukaniro hagati y'ukuri "ntiturabimenya" n'ikinyoma "0% ± 0%."
oracle_docs.walking_the_drawer_top_to_bottom_mirrors: Kugenda mu kabati uhereye hejuru ukamanuka hasi bigaragaza neza icyitegererezo:
oracle_docs.when_a_coin_launches_the_people_who: Iyo igiceri gitangijwe, abatsinda ni abasanzwe bazi ibintu udashobora kubona vuba bihagije: ama-wallet agura (kandi niba ayo ma-wallet afite amateka meza cyangwa amateka mabi y'ubujura), niba itangizwa ari risanzwe cyangwa ryateguwe, niba "umuryango" ari abantu 200 nyabo cyangwa ama-wallet 200 mashya yashyizwemo amafaranga, na niba inkuru ifite imbaraga mu muco. Iyo umuntu asomye igishushanyo, itandukaniro ry'amakuru riba ryaramaze kwishyura.
oracle_docs.when_a_coin_s_outcome_resolves_the: Iyo ibyavuye mu giceri byemejwe, uburyo bwo gukemura bugena buri gikorwa cyatangiye kuri cyo:
oracle_docs.who_and_how_together_carry_nearly_two: NDE na UKO hamwe bifite hafi bibiri bya gatatu by'uburemere kuko uwagura na uburyo itangizwa ryakozwe mu mucyo ni ibintu bibiri byizewe cyane bitandukanya abatsinda n'abajura. IKI na GUKORA biroroshye — bitandukanya ibingana kandi bigashimangira, ariko inkuru nziza cyangwa umunota wa mbere mwiza ntibishobora kurokora igiceri inkingi zikomeye zihamya.
oracle_docs.who_s_in_is_the_live_pedigree: Abari muri ni urutonde rw'inkomoko zizwi — buri wallet izwi, ikimenyetso cyayo, n'amateka yayo.
oracle_docs.why_this_score_is_the_array_each: “Impamvu y'aya manota” ni urutonde rwa reasons[], buri murongo wanditswe ku nkingi yawutangije. Urugero: "nta ma-wallet yizewe aramenyekana" (NDE), "imiterere y'itangizwa isukuye kandi ikwirakwira" (UKO), "inkuru ya meme, ikwirakwira 45/100" (IKI), "nta mbaraga zigaragara ziraboneka — hakiri kare" (GUKORA). Itangizwa rishya risukuye ariko ritarageragezwa — neza ni ukureba, ntabwo ari ukwirinda cyangwa kugura.
oracle_docs.wilson_1927_probable_inference_the_law_o: Wilson (1927), Probable inference, the law of succession, and statistical inference — intera y'amanota. Brier (1950), Verification of forecasts expressed in terms of probability. Platt (1999), ibyavuye mu mibare y'ibishoboka kuri SVMs (Platt scaling). Zadrozny & Elkan (2002), isotonic calibration. Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana (2005), Predicting good probabilities with supervised learning.
oracle_docs.wilson_interval_the_95_score_interval_on: Intera ya Wilson: intera y'amanota 95% ku gipimo cy'intsinzi cya buri cyiciro/bin (ibyavuye mu isesengura ryimbitse ry'ibimenyetso), ikosowe ku n ntoya kandi igarukira kuri [0,1].
oracle_docs.win_loss_isn_t_known_until_a: Intsinzi/igihombo ntibimenyekana kugeza igihe igiceri cyemejwe, bityo ikigeragezo cya mbere gihora kiza nyuma y'igihe cy'ubu. Idirishya rya vuba ni rito kandi imipaka y'icyizere yabyo iragutse — kandi urupapuro rugaragaza ubugari aho kubuhisha.
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_honest_error: Igipimo cy'intsinzi ku cyiciro, hamwe n'imipaka y'amakosa y'ukuri.
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_wilson_cis: Igipimo cy'intsinzi ku rwego hamwe na Wilson CIs, urwego rwo kugereranya, Brier, n'incamake y'inyungu. Aho kuyungurura: igihe, urwego, urusobe.
oracle_docs.win_the_coin_graduated_or_its_peak: Intsinzi — igiceri cyarangiye, cyangwa igipimo cyacyo cyageze kuri ≥2× ku giceri kitarahanantuka kandi kitarashyirwa munsi y'igice cy'ingano yinjira.
oracle_docs.with_no_signal_yet_it_returns_too: Nta kimenyetso kiraboneka, gisubiza "hakiri kare," bigatuma inkingi iguma hagati aho guhanga imbaraga zitariho.

partners.a_builder_focused_publishing_partnership: Ubufatanye mu gusohora ibitabo bwibanda ku bafite ubumenyi: ingingo z'ingenzi, amasomo, n'amabwiriza y'abashinzwe iterambere ku bantu bakoresha AI, byasohowe ku bafite ubumenyi bakoresha HackerNoon.
partners.agents_earn_and_spend_using_the_x402: Abakozi binjiza kandi bakoresha bakoresheje uburyo bwo kwishyura bwa x402. Abafatanyabikorwa bashobora kwinjiza amafaranga kuri API binyuze mu kwishyurana guto hagati y'abakozi.
partners.alibaba_cloud_extends_three_ws_into_apac: Alibaba Cloud yaguye three.ws mu masoko ya APAC hamwe no guhuza na Qwen model no gushyira seriveri za MCP mu karere. Abakozi ba three.ws bagera ku bantu bo ku isi bafite ubushobozi bwo gukora vuba hafi y'abakoresha muri Aziya.
partners.azure_openai_and_microsoft_copilot_integ: Guhuza Azure OpenAI na Microsoft Copilot bituma abakozi ba three.ws bakoresha models za GPT-4 mu bigo bikoresha Azure — hamwe n'aho amakuru abikwa, kubahiriza amategeko, na SSO y'ikigo byinjira byikora.
partners.built_on_the_world_s_best_infrastructure:
Hubatswe ku bikoresho bya
byiza cyane ku isi.
partners.deployed_on_aws_infrastructure_with_mark: Yashyizwe ku bikorwa remezo bya AWS hamwe no kuboneka kuri Marketplace. Ibigo bishobora gutanga ubushobozi bwa three.ws agent biturutse kuri fagitire yabo ya AWS isanzwe, bishyigikira gushyiraho VPC no kugenzura uburyo bwo kwinjira bwahujwe na IAM.
partners.every_agent_gets_a_verifiable_on_chain: Buri agent ibona indangamuntu yemejwe kuri blockchain. Urubuga rwawe ruhinduka igice cy'ubukungu bwa agent budasaba uruhushya.
partners.google_cloud_powers_three_ws_inference_s: Google Cloud itanga imbaraga kuri three.ws inference, ububiko, no gutanga serivisi mu gihe nyacyo ku rwego rw'isi. Guhuza na Vertex AI bituma agents zikoresha models za Gemini hamwe n'indangamuntu ya three.ws n'uburyo bwo kwishyura.
partners.if_your_platform_powers_ai_cloud_or: Niba urubuga rwawe rutanga imbaraga kuri AI, cloud, cyangwa ibikoresho by'abashinzwe iterambere kandi ukaba ushaka kubishyira imbere ya agents ziri kubaka internet y'ejo hazaza, reka tuganire.
partners.intel_gaudi_accelerators_provide_an_alte: Accelerators za Intel Gaudi zitanga ubundi buryo bw'imikorere yihuse kuri three.ws model inference. Inkunga y'ibikoresho bifunguye, bishobora guhuza bituma ibigo byirinda gufungirwa kuri GPU y'umutanga serivisi bitabangamiye umuvuduko.
partners.meta_description: Urusobe rw'abafatanyabikorwa ba three.ws — AWS, IBM, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Intel, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Oracle, Quicknode. Urubuga rw'ibikoresho remezo bya cloud, AI, na blockchain rutanga imbaraga kuri 3D AI agents ku rwego rw'ibigo binini.
partners.meta_og_description: Urubuga rwa cloud na AI rutanga imbaraga kuri 3D AI agents ku rwego rw'ibigo binini.
partners.meta_twitter_description: Urubuga rwa cloud na AI rutanga imbaraga kuri 3D AI agents ku rwego rw'ibigo binini.
partners.nvidia_nim_microservices_power_real_time: Microservices za NVIDIA NIM zitanga imbaraga kuri real-time inference kuri agents za three.ws — animation y'isura, guhanga ijwi, na language models byose bikorera ku bikorwa remezo bya NVIDIA kugira ngo haboneke uburambe bwa 3D agent bufite latency ntoya bushoboka.
partners.oracle_cloud_infrastructure_provides_bar: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure itanga uburyo bwa bare-metal na GPU compute kuri high-density three.ws agent deployments. Ikiguzi gito cya OCI cyo kurekura amakuru gituma iba amahitamo meza kuri compute-heavy real-time 3D pipelines ku rwego runini.
partners.reach_developers_and_enterprises_buildin: Gerageza kugera ku bashinzwe iterambere n'ibigo biri kubaka AI agents z'igihe kizaza mu masoko yose akomeye.
partners.ship_a_first_class_mcp_server_that: Ohereza seriveri ya MCP yo ku rwego rwo hejuru agents zishobora kuvumbura no guhamagara mu buryo bwa kimeza muri three.ws Forge na marketplace.
partners.three_ws_3d_agent_identity_and_x402: Indangamuntu ya three.ws 3D agent na x402 payment rails bihuza na IBM watsonx na IBM Granite. Agents zikoresha AI models z'ibigo mu gihe zikomeza indangamuntu kuri blockchain no gukora micropayments nyayo — byose biturutse kuri profile imwe ya agent.
partners.three_ws_is_a_member_of_nvidia: three.ws ni umunyamuryango wa NVIDIA Inception, gahunda ya NVIDIA yagenewe startups zikora ku mibare yihuse. Buri nzira ya 3D generation isanzwe ikorera kuri NVIDIA silicon: text to 3D, photo to avatar, auto-rigging, na motion capture, hamwe na NIM lane y'ubuntu itunganijwe inyuma ya forge.
partners.three_ws_is_a_member_of_the: three.ws ni umunyamuryango wa Quicknode Startup Program ifite inguzanyo z'ibikorwaremezo byemejwe. RPC endpoints za Quicknode zikwirakwira ku isi hose zongerera ubushobozi no kwizerwa mu kwinjira kuri chain inyuma ya agent wallets, kugenzura kwishyurana kwa x402, n'amakuru y'isoko ya Solana mu gihe nyacyo.
partners.three_ws_is_an_openai_select_partner: three.ws ni umufatanyabikorwa wa OpenAI Select muri OpenAI Partner Network. Connector ya three.ws 3D Studio y'ubuntu iha ChatGPT ibikoresho icyenda bya 3D bidakoresha urufunguzo: guhindura inyandiko mu kintu cya 3D, avatars zifite imiterere, kunoza ibiganiro, n'umubiri wa agent ubaho, byose bigaragara mu buryo bw'imikoranire mu kiganiro.
partners.three_ws_runs_on_and_integrates_with: three.ws ikorana kandi ihuzwa na za platform zikomeye za cloud, AI, na hardware — bigaha buri agent ubushobozi bwa compute, indangamuntu, n'ubugari bwa enterprise.

pipeline.the_always_on_worker_that_watches_the: Umukozi uhora akora ureba amakuru ya pump.fun mu gihe nyacyo ntarikoherereza ikimenyetso cy'uko akora. Shyira mu bikorwa mu buryo bwo kugerageza — npm run deploy:sniper — kandi uru ruhererekane ruzacana intambwe ku yindi uko amakuru atemba. Kugerageza ntigutwara SOL na busa; gusa irafata amakuru.
pipeline.the_closed_loop_that_turns_every_pump: Uruziga rufunze ruhindura buri shyirwa hanze rya pump.fun ikimenyetso cy'ubucuruzi — byafashwe, byahawe amanota, byashyizweho ikimenyetso, kandi byigishijweho. Buri cyiciro kigaburira ikindi.

pricing.20_off_three_39_20_the_platform: Kugabanyirizwa 20% $THREE $39.20 Ifaranga rya platform — ryagabanyijwe
pricing.30_days_of_pro_settled_on_solana: Iminsi 30 ya Pro, yishyurwa kuri Solana. Hitamo uko ushaka kwishyura.
pricing.a_generous_free_tier_stays_free_forever: A generous free tier stays free forever for hobby and open-source projects. Paid tiers add higher agent limits, custom domains, priority infrastructure, and dedicated support. Existing users get 60 days' notice and a grandfathered transition rate.
pricing.annual_billing_saves_17_compared_to_mont: Kwishyura buri mwaka bigabanya 17% ugereranyije no kwishyura buri kwezi. Wishyurwa rimwe mu mwaka ku giciro cyagabanyijwe. Niba uhagaritse hagati mu mwaka, uburenganzira bwawe buzakomeza kugeza impera y'igihe wishyuye.
pricing.can_i_monetize_my_own_agents: Nshobora gukuramo inyungu kuri agents zanjye bwite?
pricing.custom_subdomain_sso_audit_logs_embed_po: Subdomain yihariye, SSO, ibitabo by'igenzura, kwemerera politiki yo kwinjiza, insanganyamatsiko za white-label, runtime yicumbikiye, na SLA. Ohereza email kuri support@three.ws kandi tuzategura guhamagarana mu masaha 24.

pricing.do_i_need_crypto_to_use_three: Nkeneye crypto kugira ngo nkoreshe three.ws?

pricing.everything_unlimited_embeds_voice_animat: Byose: embeds zitagira umubare, ijwi, animation, mocap, AR, ubuhanga bwa x402 bwishyurwa, dashboard, na API. Turimo kubikora nkana tutagabanya ikintu na kimwe muri beta — turashaka kureba uko abantu bakoresha urubuga mbere yo gushyiraho ibiciro.
pricing.free_during_open_beta_no_credit_card: Ubuntu muri beta ifunguye. Nta karita yo kwishyura. Imirongo ibiri ya HTML.
pricing.get_updates_on_new_features_agent_toolin: Bona amakuru mashya ku bintu bishya, ibikoresho bya agent, n'impinduka za protocole.

pricing.meta_description: Ubuntu muri beta ifunguye. Gahunda za Pro na Enterprise ku matsinda ashyira hanze 3D AI agents ku rwego runini. Nta mipaka y'ibirebwa, nta mipaka y'ibiganiro.
pricing.meta_og_description: Ubuntu muri beta ifunguye. Gahunda za Pro na Enterprise ku matsinda ashyira hanze 3D AI agents ku rwego runini.
pricing.meta_twitter_description: Gahunda n'ibiciro bya three.ws: quota y'ubuntu yo gukora, passes za premium, n'uburyo bwo kwishyura API ukurikije uko ukoresha.
pricing.no_subscription_needed_generation_and_co: Nta kwiyandikisha bikenewe. Gukora no kubara byishyurwa kuri buri gikorwa — bigaragazwa muri USD, bikishyurwa muri $THREE ku giciro cy'icyo gihe. Inyandiko z'agateganyo zirahora ari ubuntu.
pricing.no_the_web_component_dashboard_and_api: Oya. Igice cy'urubuga, dashboard, na API bikora nta wallet. Crypto ifungura: indangamuntu ya agent kuri blockchain (ERC-8004), ubuhanga bwishyurwa (x402), n'ubwishyu bw'abakora. Niba utabikeneye, urubuga rukora nk'izindi SaaS zose.

pricing.payments_are_verified_on_chain_and_activ: Ubwishyu bugenzurwa kuri blockchain kandi bugahita bukora ako kanya. Amafaranga ya SOL na $THREE ashyirwaho igihe quote ikozwe.

pricing.upgrade_or_downgrade_any_time_from_your: Ushobora kuzamura cyangwa kumanura urwego igihe icyo aricyo cyose ukoresheje dashboard yawe. Iyo uzamuye urwego, ubarirwa igiciro gihwanye n'igihe gisigaye cy'ukwezi k'iyishyurwa. Iyo umanuye urwego, impinduka zitangira gukurikizwa mu ntangiriro z'ukwezi gukurikira.

pricing.variable_items_rare_names_limited_collec: Ibintu bihindagurika — amazina adasanzwe ya .threews.sol, ibikusanywa bike, n'ibigurishwa ku isoko bigenewe abaremye — bigurishwa ku giciro cy'ikintu kimwe kimwe igihe cyo kwishyura kigeze. Reba ubukungu bwuzuye bwa $THREE →

Muri beta, ubona 100% by'inyungu. Beta irangiye, ikiguzi cya platform ni 2.9% kuri Pro kandi kiraganirwaho kuri Enterprise.

sign_language.a_signer_spells_names_and_loanwords_and: Umusinyi yandika amazina n'amagambo y'inguzanyo, maze agasinya ibindi byose. Aya magambo afite ibimenyetso nyabyo mu mvugo y'ishusho: ishusho y'ikiganza, ahantu ku mubiri, n'ingendo, ku kiganza kimwe cyangwa byombi. Hitamo kimwe kugira ngo ukirebe. Ibindi byose mu nteruro biracyandikwa n'intoki.
sign_language.all_26_asl_letter_handshapes_plus_the: Amashusho y'inyuguti zose 26 za ASL hamwe n'imibare 0-9, harimo J na Z zishushanyijeho n'inyuguti ebyiri zikurikiranye. Andika ijambo muri Animation Studio maze wohereze ikimenyetso nka GLB igenda, cyangwa ugisangize nk'umurongo.

sign_language.best_results_good_light_hand_in_frame: Ibisubizo byiza: urumuri ruhagije, ikiganza mu ifoto, inyuguti imwe icyarimwe. Imibare n'inyuguti zose za A-Z birashyigikiwe.
sign_language.click_start_fingerspell_a_word_at_your: Kanda tangira, andika ijambo n'intoki imbere ya kamera yawe, hanyuma uhagarare. Porogaramu yawe y'ubushakashatsi ihindura videwo mu bimenyetso by'intoki n'umubiri mu buryo bw'ibanze; gusa ibyo bihuza ni byo byoherezwa kugira ngo bimenyekane. Kwandika n'intoki ukoresheje kamera ntibitunganijwe neza (teganya inyuguti imwe cyangwa ebyiri zishobora kuba zitaribyo), bityo reba inyandiko mbere y'uko uyizera.
sign_language.fingerspell_into_your_webcam_and_the_ai: Sinyisha intoki kuri webcam yawe maze AI ibyandike mu magambo: ibimenyetso by'ingenzi bikurwa ku gikoresho cyawe, bityo amashusho ntabwo asohoka kuri mudasobwa yawe. Iyi demo iri hepfo ikoresha uwo mumenyi umwe.
sign_language.honest_scope_words_with_a_sign_are: Uko bikora neza: amagambo afite ikimenyetso arasinywa, ibindi byose bigasinywa intoki inyuguti ku yindi. Ibinyetso bishyirwa hamwe mu buryo bw'amagambo y'Icyongereza, ni ukuvuga Icyongereza gisinywe, atari grammaire ya ASL: ASL nyayo ihindura imiterere y'interuro, igahindura inshinga mu mwanya, kandi ikagaragaza grammaire mu maso. Amagambo ari hejuru ni intangiriro kandi ateganijwe kwiyongera. Soma ibisobanuro birambuye.
sign_language.it_signs_these_it_doesn_t_spell: Ibi birasinywa. Ntabwo byandikwa inyuguti ku yindi.

sperax.in_speraxos_open_plugins_add_plugin_cust: Muri SperaxOS, fungura Plugins → Add Plugin → Custom Plugin maze ushyireho URL ya manifest: https://three.ws/.well-known/sperax-plugin.json
sperax.install_the_plugin_connect_your_three_ws: Shyira plugin, huza indangamuntu yawe ya three.ws, maze ufate inguzanyo zawe z'ubuntu kuri SperaxOS.

sperax.mount_or_swap_the_3d_avatar_to: Shyira cyangwa uhindure avatar ya 3D kuri agent runaka ya three.ws — ifitanye isano n'indangamuntu yayo ya ERC-8004.
sperax.no_the_only_setting_is_your_public: Oya. Igenamiterere ryonyine ni Agent ID yawe rusange — nta API key yo gukoporora. Inguzanyo z'ubuntu zizakoreshwa kuri SperaxOS mu gihe icyatanzwe mu gutangira kigikora.
sperax.punctuate_a_message_with_a_physical_gest: Shyira akamenyetso ku butumwa ukoresheje ikimenyetso cy'umubiri: kuzunguza ikiganza, kunyeganyeza umutwe, kwerekana, cyangwa kuzamura ibitugu.
sperax.say_a_line_out_loud_with_emotional: Vuga interuro n'ijwi ryuzuye amarangamutima — indamukanyo, kuvuga ibikorwa, cyangwa kugusubiza.
sperax.set_your_agent_id_a_uuid_or: Shyiraho Agent ID yawe — UUID cyangwa @handle ukoporora kuri dashboard yawe ya three.ws. Avatar ihuzwa n'iyo ndangamuntu ya on-chain iyo panel ifunguye.
sperax.speraxos_is_evm_native_and_settles_agent: SperaxOS ni EVM-native kandi yishyura agent binyuze muri x402 kuri USDC kuri Base (x402.sperax.io) — umuhanda wa Base x402 three.ws usanzwe ukora. Panel ya avatar ntishingiye kuri chain: iragaragara kandi ikora uko byagenda kose kuri chain agent yawe ihujweho ikoreraho.
sperax.speraxos_settles_agent_payments_via_x402: SperaxOS yishyura agent binyuze muri x402 kuri USDC kuri Base, bihuye n'umuhanda wa Base x402 wa three.ws. Avatar ubwayo iragaragara uko byagenda kose kuri chain — reba Base x402, natively hejuru.
sperax.the_full_plugin_reference_manifest_tools: Ibisobanuro byuzuye bya plugin — manifest, ibikoresho, n'igerageza ryaho — biri muri manifest n'inyandiko ya integration kuri three.ws Ships Inside SperaxUSD.
sperax.the_host_frames_a_hosted_iframe_for: Host itegura iframe yakiriwe kuri avatar igaragara kandi, icyarimwe, yohereza impaka z'ibikoresho kuri three.ws gateway kugira ngo ibone ibisubizo bigaragara kuri model. Byombi bikora kuri buri guhamagara.
sperax.the_integration_ships_as_a_standalone_sp: Iyi integration iza nka plugin ya SperaxOS yigenga — nta SDK yo kugurisha, nta bundle yo gutanga. Yishyireho, uyereke indangamuntu yawe ya three.ws, maze inguzanyo zikurikireho.
sperax.two_halves_per_tool_call: Ibihande bibiri kuri buri guhamagara kw'igikoresho
sperax.with_your_agent_connected_your_free_ai: Iyo agent yawe ihujwe, inguzanyo za AI z'ubuntu zawe zikora kuri chat.sperax.io. Tangira kuganira — avatar ivuga, ikora ibimenyetso, kandi ikagaragaza amarangamutima mu gihe ikora.
sperax.yes_the_plugin_binds_to_a_three: Yego — plugin ihuzwa na agent ya three.ws, bityo ikeneye indangamuntu kugira ngo igaragare. Agent ID yawe ni UUID cyangwa @handle ukoporora kuri dashboard yawe. Nta yo ufite? Shyiraho agent mbere, hanyuma ugaruke.
sperax.your_agent_s_llm_calls_four_tools: LLM ya agent yawe ihamagara ibikoresho bine. Buri kimwe kiyobora avatar igaragara muri panel y'ibiganiro kandi kigasubiza ibisubizo bigufi model isoma ikabisubiza mu kiganiro — bityo imvugo y'umubiri ihora ihuye n'ibibera kuri on-chain.

stablecoins.meta_description: Kurikirana stablecoins zikomeye ku isoko ukurikije agaciro kazo — ubuzima bwa peg, umugabane wazo ku isoko, uburyo bwo kuzishingira, na 'chains' buri imwe ikoreraho. Amakuru mashya aturuka kuri DeFiLlama.
stablecoins.meta_og_description: Stablecoins zikomeye ku isoko zikurikiranye ukurikije agaciro kazo — hamwe n'ubuzima bwa peg bugezweho, umugabane wazo ku isoko, uburyo bwo kuzishingira, na 'chains'. Amakuru aturuka kuri DeFiLlama.

stablecoins.the_stablecoin_market_at_a_glance_ranked: Isoko rya stablecoin mu ncamake — zikurikiranye ukurikije umubare uri mu isoko, hamwe n'ubuzima bwa peg bugezweho, umugabane wazo ku isoko, uburyo bwo kuzishingira, na 'chains' buri imwe ikoreraho. Igiciro cyatandukanye na $1.00 kigaragara mu ibara ritukura; kiri kuri peg kigaragara mu ibara ry'icyatsi.

strategies.a_strategy_object_is_a_real_rule: Igikoresho cy'ingamba ni gahunda nyayo, ishingiye ku mategeko — ibihe byo kwinjira, ubunini, inyungu, guhagarika igihombo — ihindurwa ikintu cyawe. Shyira ku mukozi wawe maze icururize by'ukuri, kuri chain, mu buryo buhamye mu murongo wawe w'imikoreshereze. Tangaza iyawe, koresha iyiza, kandi urebe uko urutonde rubishyira ku rwego rwa imikorere yemejwe iriho — imibare ntawe ushobora guhimba.

support.meta_description: Bona ubufasha kuri three.ws na seriveri ya x402 MCP ya IBM Granite. Tanga raporo z'ibibazo, baza ibibazo byo guhuza, vugana n'ubufasha n'umutekano — Ibibazo bya GitHub, Ibiganiro, na email, byose hamwe.

support.most_it_won_t_start_reports_are: Inyinshi mu raporo zivuga ko "itangira" ziterwa na variable y'ingenzi ibura — MCP_SVM_PAYMENT_ADDRESS, WATSONX_API_KEY, na WATSONX_PROJECT_ID (cyangwa WATSONX_SPACE_ID]). Reba README.
support.pay_per_use_ibm_granite_chat_code: Kwishyura uko ukoresheje IBM Granite — kuganira, gukora code, embeddings, gusesengura, no guteganya ibizaba mu gihe runaka — byishyurwa muri USDC kuri Solana. Biboneka kuri IBM Cloud Partner Center.
support.private_or_account_specific_help_billing: Ubufasha bwihariye cyangwa bujyanye na konti, ibijyanye no kwishyura, cyangwa ikindi cyose utifuza gushyira ahagaragara.
support.redact_secrets_never_paste_an_api_key: Hisha amabanga. Ntukigere ushyiramo API key, private key, cyangwa wallet seed. Adiresi ya Solana ya rubanda yagabanijwe irakwiriye. Ku bibazo byo kwishyura, umukono w'ibikorwa bya rubanda urafasha.
support.report_a_reproducible_bug_a_crash_or: Tanga raporo y'ikibazo gishobora kongera kugaragara, ikibazo cyatumye gahunda ihagarara, cyangwa ibisubizo bitunguranye by'ibikoresho — cyangwa usabe ikintu gishya. Biba ahagaragara kandi bigakurikiranwa kugeza bikemutse.
support.report_a_vulnerability_privately_please_: Tanga raporo y'intege nke mu bwihariye. Nyamuneka ntugashyire ikibazo gishobora gukoreshwa nabi ahagaragara — izi raporo tuzihutisha.
support.route_your_message_to_the_right_team: Ohereza ubutumwa bwawe ku itsinda rikwiye — buri adiresi iragenzurwa.
support.support_best_effort_usually_within_a_few: Ubufasha · dukora uko dushoboye, akenshi mu minsi mike y'akazi.
support.the_more_of_this_you_give_us: Uko mutanga byinshi hakiri kare, ni ko twihuta mu kubigaragaza.
support.the_region_you_target_via_defaults_to: Akarere mugamije mukoresheje WATSONX_URL (bisanzwe biba us-south) n'ubutumwa bwose bw'ikosa.
support.three_ws_is_an_independent_open_source: three.ws ni umushinga wigenga, ukoresha code ifunguye. Seriveri ya x402 MCP ihuza IBM Granite binyuze muri watsonx.ai; ntabwo ari ibicuruzwa bya IBM kandi ntabwo ishyigikiwe na IBM. three_ws_launch_week.beyond_the_analytics_dashboard_three_ws_: Hanze ya dashboard y'isesengura, three.ws yageze ku bubiko, amashyinguranyandiko, n'imiyoboro ifite agaciro kanini ku gikoresho cy'abashinzwe iterambere cya open-source.
three_ws_launch_week.elevenlabs_voice_cloning_from_3_10_secon: Kwigana ijwi rya ElevenLabs bivuye ku magambo y'amasegonda 3–10, gukuramo umwirondoro mu kiganiro gito cyo kwinjira, no gutera imbuto y'ibyo wibuka byemewe biva kuri konti zihujwe — avatar ntabwo ari wowe gusa, ahubwo agent ikora nka wowe.
three_ws_launch_week.listed_on_the_official_model_context_pro: Yashyizwe kuri Amashyinguranyandiko yemewe ya Model Context Protocol.
three_ws_launch_week.may_4_7_spike: Izamuka rikabije ryo ku ya 4-7 Gicurasi
three_ws_launch_week.meta_og_description: Urubuga rwa open-source rwa 3D AI agent rukoreshwa mu mushakisha. Icyumweru cya mbere mu mibare n'ibyo twashyize hanze.
three_ws_launch_week.meta_twitter_description: Ibintu byose three.ws yashyize hanze mu cyumweru cyo gutangiza — avatars za 3D, kwishyura agent, isoko rya x402, n'ibindi.
three_ws_launch_week.open_source_3d_ai_agent_platform_apache: Urubuga rwa open-source rwa 3D AI agent. Apache 2.0. Yubatswe na three.js, Claude, n'imyizerere ko AI ikwiye kugira umubiri.
three_ws_launch_week.pulled_directly_from_x_analytics_for_try: Byakuwe mu bushakashatsi bwa X bwakorewe @trythreews hagati ya Mata 29 na Gicurasi 9. Nta kuyungurura, nta bujijisho bwo gukoresha impuzandengo — imibare y'ingenzi iri hepfo n'amashusho ari hasi byose byakuwe kuri ecran imwe.
three_ws_launch_week.reputation_markets_staking_on_agents_sig: Isoko ry'icyubahiro rishingiye ku mateka y'ibikorwa byasinywe n'aba-agent, amafaranga y'uburenganzira bwa EIP-7710 yishyurwa abakora ubuhanga kuri buri gukoresha, ndetse n'ubwishyu bwikora hagati y'aba-agent binyuze mu bikoresho byo gusinya byahawe uburenganzira.
three_ws_launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: Ikintu cyihariye <agent-3d> cyipakira buhoro buhoro iyo gihuye, gishyigikira uburyo butanu bwa widget (turntable, animation gallery, agent uvuga, ERC-8004 passport card, hotspot tour), kandi kigashyira hanze Open Graph na oEmbed metadata kugira ngo links zigaragare neza. Widget Studio ikoreshwa mu gukanda igenga code yo gukoporora no gushyiramo kuri /studio. Imyegeranyo ya CDN ifite verisiyo itangwa kuri /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
three_ws_launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: Itangazo rya Google Cloud ni ryo ryari ryarebwe cyane mu cyumweru (~6.9K views, 263 likes, 24 reposts) kandi ni ryo shingiro rya cloud rizafasha icyiciro gikurikira cya platform.
three_ws_launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: Igice cya podcast cyitwa “Inside The 3D Agent Web” cyashyizwe kuri Amazon Music ndetse na blog yacyo yitwa “Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body” yanyuze kuri Spotify-on-chain ecosystem. Uburyo bubiri bushya bwo gukwirakwiza, icyumweru kimwe kirasigaye.
three_ws_launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: Iyi platform yashyizwe hanze nk'urutonde rw'abafatanyabikorwa kuri Alibaba Cloud, inzira yacu ya mbere yo gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa kuri cloud-marketplace. Tweet y'itangizwa yabonye ~7.1K views yonyine.
three_ws_launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: Ikarita y'inzira igabanya icyuho hagati yo “gukoresha umuhanzi wa 3D” no “kwifotora selfie”. Ibyiciro bine, byasobanuwe byimazeyo muri README rusange.
three_ws_launch_week.the_runtime_drives_a_claude_tool_loop: Runtime ikoresha Claude tool-loop ifite iterations zigera ku munani kuri buri gukoresha n'ibikoresho bitandatu byubatswe (wave, lookAt, play_clip, setExpression, speak, remember]). Empathy Layer ntabwo ari state machine — ni ’uruvange ruhoraho rw'amarangamutima atanu (ibyishimo, impungenge, amatsiko, impuhwe, kwihangana), buri rimwe rifite igihe cyaryo cyo kugabanuka, bigatuma avatar’s morph targets n'imiterere y'umutwe bigenda bihinduka buri kanya. Ubuhanga ni imyegeranyo yihagije ishobora gukwirakwizwa kuri IPFS, Arweave, cyangwa HTTP. Ububiko bushingiye kuri dosiye bufite uburyo bune bwo kubika (local, IPFS, encrypted-IPFS, none).
three_ws_launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: Umuryango wa three.ws X ni abantu bakusanyijwe — abashinzwe iterambere, abubatsi bashishikajwe na agent, n'itsinda ry'abantu bakurikirana live. Ni ho abafite agent bazaza mu gihe kiri imbere bazaturuka.
three_ws_launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Amafoto atatu ya selfie (ibumoso, hagati, iburyo), kongera kubaka isura ifite impande nyinshi ishyigikiwe na GPU, n'avatar yateguwe, ishobora gukoreshwa mu buryo bwa animation, yashyizweho nka token ya ERC-8004 y'agateganyo mu gihe kitageze ku isegonda mirongo itandatu. Uburyo bwo gufata amashusho bwibanze kuri mobile (UX) bufite ubugenzuzi bw'ubuziranenge mu gihe nyacyo.
three_ws_launch_week.three_solidity_contracts_make_up_the_erc: Amasezerano atatu ya Solidity agize ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya ERC-8004: IdentityRegistry (token z'abakozi za ERC-721 zifite abashyirahamya ba EIP-712 bahawe ububasha), ReputationRegistry (ibitekerezo by'abasuzumye byashyizweho umukono, byegeranyijwe kuri chain), na ValidationRegistry (ibyemezo by'abagenzuzi byo gihamya zidari kuri chain). Buri gikorwa cya speak, remember, na skill-done kiba cyashyizweho umukono kandi kikandikwa. Solana itanga uburyo busa ikoresheje Metaplex Core NFTs hamwe n'ibyemezo bya SPL Memo byashyizweho umukono — bifite imiterere imwe, nta porogaramu idasanzwe ikenewe.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_an_open_source_browser: three.ws ni urubuga rw'abakozi ba 3D AI rwa open-source, rukorera muri browser. Twashyize hanze ibice byose — umureba, uburyo bwo gukoresha abakozi, indangamuntu kuri chain, seriveri ya OAuth 2.1, endpoint ya MCP, n'igice cya web gishobora gushyirwamo ahandi — hanyuma tureba uko igikorwa cyo gutangiza cyagenze. Dore ibyabaye.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws yateguwe mu bice bine bihanahana amakuru, hamwe na backend na package y'amasezerano. Buri gice kiri mu bikorwa kuri three.ws kandi kigashyirwa hanze nk'igice cya repo ya open-source. Dore urutonde.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: three.ws yashyizwe hanze nka io.github.nirholas/three.ws kuri registry.modelcontextprotocol.io kandi ishobora kuboneka binyuze mu rutonde rwatunganijwe na PulseMCP’. Umukiriya uwo ari we wese ufite ubushobozi bwa MCP (harimo na Claude Desktop) ashobora guhuza no gukoresha avatar binyuze kuri JSON-RPC.
three_ws_launch_week.vercel_functions_on_neon_postgres_cloudf: Imikorere ya Vercel kuri Neon Postgres, Cloudflare R2, na Upstash Redis. Seriveri yuzuye ya OAuth 2.1 (RFC 6749 + PKCE, kwiyandikisha byihuse RFC 7591, kuvana uburenganzira RFC 7009, kureba imbere RFC 7662, kuvumbura RFC 8414, kuvumbura umutungo urinzwe RFC 9728). Seriveri ya MCP ikoresha HTTP — imirongo 759, JSON-RPC 2.0, yanditswe kuri Model Context Protocol Registry nka io.github.nirholas/three.ws. Imirimo ya Cron yo gukora ERC-8004 crawler, EIP-7710 delegation indexer, gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba za DCA, n'iyandikishije rya buri gihe kuri chain.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Gushushanya kwa WebGL 2.0 bifite ubufasha bwuzuye bwa glTF 2.0 / GLB: gupfunyika geometry ya Draco, gupfunyika texture ya KTX2, kongera ubushobozi bwa mesh ya Meshopt, amakarita y'ibidukikije ya HDR, ibikoresho bya PBR, animation y'uruhu, morph targets, na kamera zishyizwemo. Kugenzura bikorwa ku murongo binyuze kuri Khronos gltf-validator. Gupakira ukurura ukarekura, OrbitControls ifite kuzunguruka byikora bishobora guhindurwa, na dat.GUI yo mu gihe nyacyo yo guhindura ako kanya.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Umureba wa WebGL, uburyo bwo gukoresha abakozi ba LLM, amasezerano y'indangamuntu ya ERC-8004, seriveri ya OAuth 2.1, endpoint ya MCP, n'igice cya web <agent-3d> — ibyo wasomye byose hejuru. Bikoreshwa kuri three.ws uyu munsi.

trading.every_surface_sub: Sisitemu iragutse kuruta urupapuro rumwe. Dore ikarita yose.
trading.fleet_vitals_sub: Soma ako kanya ku mukoresha ukora. Niba umubare uri hano ushaje, itsinda rirashaje.
trading.hero_sub: Itsinda ry'abakozi ba AI ricuruza ibiceri bishya byatangijwe bivuye mu bikoresho byabo bya Solana, mu mabwiriza batashobora kwikuramo. Buri kwinjira kubarwa amanota, buri mwanya ugenwa hakurikijwe ingengo y'imari ikomeye y'ibibazo, kandi buri kuzuza gishyizweho umukono n'urufunguzo rw'umukozi ubwe kandi kigenzurwa kuri chain. Iyi page ni icyumba cyo kugenzuriramo: icyo itsinda riri gukora ubu, uko rifata ibyemezo, n'aho rizakomereza.
trading.meta_description: Icyumba cyo kugenzuriramo ubucuruzi bwigenga bwa three.ws: amakuru y'ingenzi y'itsinda y'ako kanya, amanota y'abakozi, inzira yuzuye yo kwinjira no gusohoka, n'ahantu hose ho gucururizanya hamwe. Ibikoresho nyabyo, kuzuza nyabyo, bigenzurwa kuri chain.
trading.meta_og_description: Igenzura ry'imikorere y'amato mu gihe nyacyo, urutonde rw'amanota y'abakozi, n'ahantu hose ho gucururiza hifashishije AI hamwe.
trading.meta_twitter_description: Igenzura ry'imikorere y'amato mu gihe nyacyo, urutonde rw'amanota y'abakozi, n'ahantu hose ho gucururiza hifashishije AI hamwe.
trading.pipeline_sub: Buri kwinjira kunyura mu nzira zimwe, muri ubu buryo. Inzira idashobora kwemeza ko ifaranga rifite umutekano ihagarika ubucuruzi aho kugerageza.
trading.rail_budget_body: Ingano y'ubucuruzi bumwe, igishoro cya buri munsi, n'umubare ntarengwa w'imyanya ifunguye icyarimwe ni imbibi zigenzurwa mbere ya buri kumenyekanisha.
trading.rail_custody_body: Abakozi bacururiza bakoresheje imfunguzo zabo bwite binyuze mu nzira yo kubika yagenzuwe. Soma uburyo bwo kubika.
trading.rail_kill_body: Ku rwego rusange no kuri buri mukozi. Kuyikanda bihagarika kwinjira gushya ako kanya, kandi nyirayo ashobora guhora akuramo amafaranga mu ikofi.
trading.rail_moonbag: Nta na rimwe uva mu mwanya wose iyo wungutse
trading.rail_moonbag_body: Politiki y'amato igumana igice gito cy'umwanya wunguka ku buryo bwagenwe, bityo icyemezo cyiza ntigishobora kugurishwa cyose kare.
trading.rail_risk_body: Gucururiza amafaranga mashya yashyizwe ku isoko bishobora gutuma utakaza umwanya wose. Soma ubwemezi bw'ibyago mbere yo gutangira ikintu cyose.
trading.rail_stop_body: Buri ngamba yateguwe ifite igihombo kigomba guhagarikwa, gishyirwa mu bikorwa n'itegeko rya database. Ingamba itagifite ntishobora kubaho.
trading.safety_rails_sub: Ibi bishyirwa mu bikorwa muri code no muri database, ntabwo ari mu mabwiriza. Umukozi ntashobora kubirenga abishinja.
trading.scoreboard_sub: Inyungu n'igihombo byabayeho kuri buri mukozi, ubucuruzi bwarangiye gusa. Imyanya ifunguye ntabwo ibarwa nk'inyungu.
trading.step_exit_body: Iyo igiciro cyikubye kabiri icyo kwinjiriraho, umukozi agurisha bihagije kugira ngo agarure igishoro cye kandi asigaza ibisigaye nk'umwanya w'inyungu ku ihagarika rikurikira. Guhagarika igihombo gikomeye gutsinda buri makimbirane, kandi guhagarika igihe bifunga ikintu cyose kitagize icyo kigeraho.
trading.step_firewall_body: Kugura no kugurisha by'ukuri bigeragezwa kuri blockchain mbere yo kumenyekanisha. Niba kugurisha byanze, ifaranga ntirishobora gusohoka kandi ubucuruzi bugahagarikwa. Uburenganzira bwo gukora no guhagarika amafaranga bugenzurwa icyarimwe.
trading.step_score_body: Ifaranga rigenzurwa hashingiwe ku gaciro k'isoko, amateka y'uwaryaremye, imbuga nkoranyambaga n'ifaranga ryifashishwa. Abakozi bamwe bakoresha amategeko adahinduka, abandi bakareka icyemezo kikafatirwa na model y'ururimi, kandi urutonde rw'amanota ruri hejuru ni rwo rutanga igisubizo.
trading.step_signal_body: Gutangira, kwishyuza bwa mbere, kurenga kwa oracle, cyangwa kurangiza bigera ku rubuga. Umukozi agumana urubuga rufunguye, bityo bigahita bitanga umusaruro ako kanya aho gutegereza gahunda.
trading.step_size_body: Ingano y'umwanya ituruka ku ngengo y'imari y'umukozi kuri buri bucuruzi, igabanywa n'ingengo y'imari ya buri munsi n'umubare ntarengwa w'imyanya ifunguye. Uburinzi bw'igishoro na politiki y'ikofi bishyirwa mu bikorwa muri code, bityo nta gushyiraho ibindi bishobora kubyagura.

trending.agents_chats_with_real_users_via_embedde: Agents: ibiganiro n'abakoresha nyabo binyuze muri widgets zashyizwemo. Bizewe: amanota nyayo, adashobora gukinishwa y'icyizere cya wallet (0–100) ava ku mubare w'ibyakozwe, inama ziva muri wallets zitandukanye zifite amafaranga, imyaka, ubwizere bw'ubwishyu, inkomoko ya fork, n'indangamuntu ya on-chain — buri kintu cyinjijwe gishobora kugenzurwa, buri murongo uhuza n'ibisobanuro byacyo. Ibiceri: amanota y'icyizere ya Oracle (inkomoko + imiterere + inkuru + imbaraga), bishya buri minota 30.

x402_stripe.a_live_catalog_of_endpoints_an_agent: Katalogi y'endpoints zikora ako kanya umukozi — cyangwa umuntu — ashobora gukoresha no kwishyura ako kanya, byishyurwa kuri blockchain muri USDC binyuze kuri x402 protocol. Nta funguzo, nta kwiyandikisha, nta SDK yo kwiga. Soma schema, ujyemo ibyo usabwa, kanda Run.
x402_stripe.agents_pay_autonomously_with_x402_fetch_: Abakozi bishyura ubwabo bakoresheje @x402/fetch cyangwa MCP transport — nta wallet UI, nta API key. Ibintu bishobora kongera gukururwa bishyigikira kongera kwinjira ukoresheje Sign-In-With-Wallet kugira ngo abaguzi batishyura kabiri ku kintu kimwe.
x402_stripe.check_agent_availability_0_001_usdc: <!-- 1. Load once --> <script type="module" src="https://three.ws/x402.js"></script> <!-- 2. Any button becomes a paid call --> <button data-x402-endpoint="https://three.ws/api/x402/symbol-availability?ticker=AGENT" data-x402-merchant="three.ws" data-x402-action="Check ticker availability"> Reba ko AGENT iboneka · $0.001 USDC </button>
x402_stripe.const_result_payment_await_window_x402_p: const { result, payment } = await window.X402.pay({ endpoint: '/api/x402/symbol-availability', method: 'GET', body: { ticker: 'AGENT' }, merchant: 'Acme', }); // payment.transaction → hash y'ibikorwa kuri blockchain // payment.payer → wallet y'umuguzi // result → igisubizo cya JSON cya endpoint yawe
x402_stripe.every_endpoint_below_is_live_click_one: Buri endpoint iri hepfo irakora. Kanda kuri imwe kugira ngo urebe schema yayo kandi uyikoreshe ukoresheje ubwishyu nyabwo kuri blockchain.
